model.studocu.int_data_engineering__meta.name: int_data_engineering__metabase_usage
model.studocu.int_data_engineering__meta.raw_code:
WITH athena AS (
    SELECT
        'athena' AS engine,
        start_time as start_datetime,
        count(distinct query_id) as queries        
    FROM
        {{ ref('stg_data_engineering__athena_last_queries') }}
    WHERE
        "sql" LIKE '%-- Metabase%'
        AND status = 'SUCCEEDED'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
redshift AS (
    SELECT
        'redshift' AS engine,
        start_time as start_datetime,
        count(distinct query_id) as queries        
    FROM
        {{ ref('stg_data_engineering__redshift_last_queries') }}
    WHERE
        "sql" LIKE '%partner: "metabase"%'
        AND aborted = 0
        AND optional_user_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2
), unions as (
    SELECT
        *
    FROM
        athena
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        *
    FROM
        redshift        
)
SELECT
    *
FROM
    unions

model.studocu.int_universities_stage_log.name: int_universities_stage_logs
model.studocu.int_universities_stage_log.raw_code:
WITH dates AS (
    SELECT
        "date"
    FROM
        {{ ref('stg_general__calendar') }}
    WHERE
        "date" >= CAST(
            '2015-01-01' AS DATE
        )
),
current_stage_per_day AS (
    SELECT
        dates.date,
        institution.id,
        institution.phase
    FROM
        dates
        CROSS JOIN {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__institution') }} AS institution
),
stage_logs AS (
    SELECT
        current_stage_per_day.date,
        current_stage_per_day.id,
        MAX(
            logs.new_stage
        ) over (
            PARTITION BY current_stage_per_day.id
            ORDER BY
                current_stage_per_day.date rows BETWEEN unbounded preceding
                AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS max_stage,
        MIN(
            logs.current_stage
        ) over (
            PARTITION BY current_stage_per_day.id
        ) AS min_stage,
        current_stage_per_day.phase AS current_stage
    FROM
        current_stage_per_day
        LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_metrics_studocu__institution_stage_log') }} AS logs
        ON logs.institution_id = current_stage_per_day.id
        AND CAST(
            logs.created_at AS DATE
        ) = CAST(
            current_stage_per_day.date AS DATE
        )
)
SELECT
    stage_logs.date,
    stage_logs.id,
    COALESCE(
        stage_logs.max_stage,
        stage_logs.min_stage,
        stage_logs.current_stage
    ) AS stage
FROM
    stage_logs

model.studocu.int_ai_qa__question_answer.name: int_ai_qa__question_answers
model.studocu.int_ai_qa__question_answer.raw_code:
WITH first_question_answers AS (
    SELECT
        comment_subject.subject_id as post_id,
        comment.id,
        comment.comment, --can we remove html tags here?
        comment.created_at,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY comment_subject.subject_id ORDER BY comment.created_at) as rank
    FROM 
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__comment_subject') }} as comment_subject
    INNER JOIN
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__comment') }} as comment
        ON comment.id = comment_subject.comment_id
    INNER JOIN 
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__post') }} as post
        ON comment_subject.subject_id = post.id
    WHERE
        post.type <> 'ORGANIC'
        AND comment_subject.subject_type = 'Post'
),
answer_types AS (
    SELECT 
        comment_subject.subject_id as post_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT comment.id) as count_comments,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN comment.user_id = post.user_id THEN comment.id END) as count_comments_user,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN comment.user_id = assigned_questions.expert_id THEN comment.id END) as count_comments_expert
    FROM 
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__comment_subject') }} as comment_subject
    INNER JOIN
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__comment') }} as comment
        ON comment.id = comment_subject.comment_id
    INNER JOIN
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__post') }} as post
        ON comment_subject.subject_id = post.id
    LEFT JOIN
        {{ ref('int_ai_qa__assigned_questions') }} as assigned_questions
        ON comment_subject.subject_id = assigned_questions.post_id
    WHERE
        post.type <> 'ORGANIC'
        AND comment_subject.subject_type = 'Post'
    GROUP BY    
        1
)
SELECT
    first_question_answers.post_id,
    first_question_answers.id as first_answer_id,
    first_question_answers.created_at as first_answer_created_at,
    first_question_answers.comment as first_answer_content,
    'https://www.studocu.com/en-gb/messages/question/' || first_question_answers.post_id as question_url,
    answer_types.count_comments,
    answer_types.count_comments_user,
    answer_types.count_comments_expert
FROM
    first_question_answers
INNER JOIN
    answer_types
    ON first_question_answers.post_id = answer_types.post_id
WHERE   
    first_question_answers.rank = 1

model.studocu.int_ai_qa__assigned_questi.name: int_ai_qa__assigned_questions
model.studocu.int_ai_qa__assigned_questi.raw_code:
WITH assigned_posts AS (
    SELECT
        post_assigned.post_id,
        MIN(post_assigned.created_at) as first_assigned_at,
        MAX(post_assigned.created_at) as last_assigned_at,
        MIN(post_assigned.finished_at) as answered_at,
        MAX(post_assigned.deleted_at) as last_deleted_at
    FROM
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__post_assigned') }} as post_assigned
    INNER JOIN 
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__post') }} as post
        ON post_assigned.post_id = post.id
    WHERE
        post.type <> 'ORGANIC'
    GROUP BY
        1
),
last_expert_assigned AS (
    SELECT
        post_assigned.post_id,
        post_assigned.user_id as expert_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY post_assigned.post_id ORDER BY post_assigned.created_at DESC) as rank
    FROM
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__post_assigned') }} as post_assigned
    INNER JOIN 
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__post') }} as post
        ON post_assigned.post_id = post.id
    WHERE
        post.type <> 'ORGANIC'
)
SELECT
    assigned_posts.post_id,
    last_expert_assigned.expert_id,
    assigned_posts.first_assigned_at,
    assigned_posts.last_assigned_at,
    assigned_posts.answered_at,
    assigned_posts.last_deleted_at
FROM
    assigned_posts
LEFT JOIN
    last_expert_assigned
    ON assigned_posts.post_id = last_expert_assigned.post_id
    AND last_expert_assigned.rank = 1

    SELECT
        answer_id,
        COUNT(1) as total_rag_references,
        listagg(DISTINCT document_id, ',') as list_rag_doc_ids,
        LENGTH(list_rag_doc_ids) - LENGTH(REPLACE(list_rag_doc_ids, ',', '')) + LEAST(total_rag_references,1)  as unique_rag_docs_referenced
    FROM
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__question_answer_sources') }}

        1
)

    *

model.studocu.int_ai_qa__recommended_que.name: int_ai_qa__recommended_questions
model.studocu.int_ai_qa__recommended_que.raw_code:
WITH recommended_questions AS (
    SELECT  
        post_views.post_id,
        post_views.course_id,
        post_views.subject_id,
        'RECOMMENDED' as "type",
        COUNT(*) as view_count
    FROM
        {{ ref('stg_metrics_studocu__post_views') }} post_views
    LEFT JOIN
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__post') }} post
        ON post_views.post_id = post.id
    WHERE 
        post_views.created_at <= DATEADD(month, -6, CURRENT_DATE)
        AND post.type != 'ORGANIC'
    GROUP BY
        1,
        2,
        3,
        4
),
-- Aggreed to order questions that tie on view_count() randomly
random_ranks AS (
    SELECT 
        post_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY course_id ORDER BY RANDOM()) AS random_rank
    FROM 
        recommended_questions
),
recommended_questions_sorted AS (
    SELECT
        recommended_questions.*,
        random_ranks.random_rank
    FROM 
        recommended_questions
    INNER JOIN
        random_ranks
        ON recommended_questions.post_id = random_ranks.post_id
    ORDER BY
        2,
        5 DESC,
        6
)
SELECT  
    post_id,
    course_id,
    subject_id,
    "type",
    view_count
FROM
    recommended_questions_sorted

model.studocu.int_ai_qa__dismissed_quest.name: int_ai_qa__dismissed_questions
model.studocu.int_ai_qa__dismissed_quest.raw_code:
WITH dismissed_posts AS (
    SELECT
        user_dismissed_post.post_id,
        MIN(user_dismissed_post.created_at) as dismissed_at
    FROM
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__user_dismissed_post') }} as user_dismissed_post
    INNER JOIN 
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__post') }} as post
        ON user_dismissed_post.post_id = post.id
    WHERE
        post.type <> 'ORGANIC'
    GROUP BY
        1
),
dismissed_reason AS (
    SELECT
        dismissed_posts.post_id,
        post_dismiss_reason.reason,
        user_dismissed_post.additional_data
    FROM 
        dismissed_posts
    INNER JOIN
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__user_dismissed_post') }} as user_dismissed_post
        ON dismissed_posts.post_id = user_dismissed_post.post_id AND dismissed_posts.dismissed_at = user_dismissed_post.created_at
    INNER JOIN
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__post_dismiss_reason') }} as post_dismiss_reason
        ON user_dismissed_post.post_dismiss_reason_id = post_dismiss_reason.id
    INNER JOIN 
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__post') }} as post
        ON user_dismissed_post.post_id = post.id
    WHERE
        post.type <> 'ORGANIC'
)
SELECT
    dismissed_posts.*,
    dismissed_reason.reason as dismissed_reason,
    dismissed_reason.additional_data as dismissed_reason_additional_info
FROM
    dismissed_posts
LEFT JOIN
    dismissed_reason
    ON dismissed_posts.post_id = dismissed_reason.post_id

model.studocu.int_ai_qa__questions.name: int_ai_qa__questions
model.studocu.int_ai_qa__questions.raw_code:
WITH expert_question_views AS (
    SELECT
        *
    FROM    
        {{ ref('int_ai_qa__question_views') }}
),
dismissed_questions AS (
    SELECT
        *
    FROM
        {{ (ref('int_ai_qa__dismissed_questions')) }}
),
assigned_questions AS (
    SELECT
        *
    FROM
        {{ (ref('int_ai_qa__assigned_questions')) }}
),
question_answers AS (
    SELECT
        *
    FROM
        {{ (ref('int_ai_qa__question_answers')) }}
),
comment_last_rating AS (
    SELECT
        *
    FROM
        {{ (ref('int_ai_qa__comment_last_rating') )}}
),
rag_doc_answer_link AS (
    SELECT
        *
    FROM
        {{ (ref('int_ai_qa__rag_doc_answer_link') )}}
),
questions AS (
    SELECT
        post.id as post_id,
        post.type  as post_type,
        CASE
            WHEN post.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'deleted'
            WHEN dismissed_questions.dismissed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'dismissed'
            WHEN question_answers.first_answer_created_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'answered'
            WHEN (assigned_questions.last_assigned_at >= assigned_questions.last_deleted_at) 
                 OR (assigned_questions.last_assigned_at IS NOT NULL AND assigned_questions.last_deleted_at IS NULL) THEN 'work in progress'
            WHEN assigned_questions.last_assigned_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'assigned but dropped'
            ELSE 'pending'
        END as "status",
        post.created_at,
        post.deleted_at,
        dismissed_questions.dismissed_at,
        assigned_questions.first_assigned_at,
        question_answers.first_answer_created_at as answered_at,
        post.is_anonymous,
        post.user_id,
        assigned_questions.expert_id,
        post.content as question_content, --can we remove html tags from content?
        question_answers.first_answer_content,
        question_answers.first_answer_id,
        rag.total_rag_references,
        rag.unique_rag_docs_referenced,
        rag.list_rag_doc_ids,
        p2p_answers_reviews.invalid_question_do_not_pay,
        p2p_answers_reviews.feedback,
        question_answers.question_url,
        comment_rating.created_at as rated_at, --double check if this is unique on comment_id
        comment_rating.rating,
        comment_rating.additional_information as rating_additional_info,
        dismissed_questions.dismissed_reason,
        dismissed_questions.dismissed_reason_additional_info,
        post_replied_to.test_rag,
        question_answers.count_comments,
        question_answers.count_comments_user,
        question_answers.count_comments_expert,
        subject.id as subject_id, --double check if post_subject is unique on post_id (for type 'subject')
        subject.name as subject_name,
        dim_group_subjects.subject_group_name,
        post_course.subject_id as course_id,
        course.name as course_name,
        institution.id as institution_id,
        institution.name as institution_name,
        institution.country_id as institution_country_id,
        institution.region_code as institution_region_code,
        institution.level as institution_level,
        institution.phase as institution_phase,
        grade.id as grade_id,
        grade.name as grade_name,
        degree.id as degree_id,
        degree.name as degree_name,
        degree.phase as degree_phase,
        country.name as institution_country_name,
        country_tier.tier,
        language.language_geocode as country_language,
        COALESCE(expert_question_views.lifetime_unique_page_views, 0) as lifetime_unique_page_views,
        COALESCE(expert_question_views.lifetime_unique_page_views_seo, 0) as lifetime_unique_page_views_seo,
        COALESCE(expert_question_views.lifetime_total_page_views, 0) as lifetime_total_page_views,
        COALESCE(expert_question_views.lifetime_total_page_views_seo, 0) as lifetime_total_page_views_seo,
        DATEDIFF(minute, post.created_at, assigned_questions.first_assigned_at) as minutes_created_to_assign,
        DATEDIFF(minute, post.created_at, question_answers.first_answer_created_at) as minutes_created_to_answer,
        DATEDIFF(minute, assigned_questions.first_assigned_at, question_answers.first_answer_created_at) as minutes_assign_to_answer,
        DATEDIFF(minute, post.created_at, LEAST(question_answers.first_answer_created_at, dismissed_questions.dismissed_at, post.deleted_at)) as minutes_created_to_resolved
    FROM
        {{ (ref('stg_production_studocu__post')) }} as post
    LEFT JOIN  
        dismissed_questions 
        ON post.id = dismissed_questions.post_id
    LEFT JOIN   
        assigned_questions
        ON post.id = assigned_questions.post_id
    LEFT JOIN
        question_answers
        ON post.id = question_answers.post_id
    LEFT JOIN
        comment_last_rating as comment_rating
        ON question_answers.first_answer_id = comment_rating.comment_id
    LEFT JOIN 
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__post_subject')}} as post_subject
        ON post.id = post_subject.post_id
        AND post_subject.subject_type = 'Subject'
    LEFT JOIN   
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__subject')}} as subject
        ON post_subject.subject_id = subject.id
    LEFT JOIN
        {{ ref('stg_ai_qa__fact_group_subjects') }} as fact_group_subjects
        ON post_subject.subject_id = fact_group_subjects.subject_id
    LEFT JOIN
        {{ ref('stg_ai_qa__dim_group_subjects') }} as dim_group_subjects
        ON fact_group_subjects.subject_group_id = dim_group_subjects.subject_group_id
    LEFT JOIN 
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__post_subject')}} as post_course
        ON post.id = post_course.post_id
        AND post_course.subject_type = 'Course'
    LEFT JOIN
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__course') }} as course
        ON post_course.subject_id = course.id

model.studocu.int_ai_qa__questions.compiled_code:
WITH expert_question_views AS (
    SELECT
        *
    FROM    
        "production"."intermediate"."question_vieww"
),
dismissed_questions AS (
    SELECT
        *
    FROM
        "production"."intermediate"."dismissed_questions"
),
assigned_questions AS (
    SELECT
        *
    FROM
        "production"."intermediate"."assigned_questions"
),
question_answers AS (
    SELECT
        *
    FROM
        "production"."intermediate"."question_answers"
),
comment_last_rating AS (
    SELECT
        *
    FROM
        "production"."intermediate"."int_ai_qa__comment_last_rating"
),
rag_doc_answer_link AS (
    SELECT
        *
    FROM
        "production"."intermediate"."int_ai_qa__rag_doc_answer_link"
),
questions AS (
    SELECT
        post.id as post_id,
        post.type  as post_type,
        CASE
            WHEN post.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'deleted'
            WHEN dismissed_questions.dismissed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'dismissed'
            WHEN question_answers.first_answer_created_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'answered'
            WHEN (assigned_questions.last_assigned_at >= assigned_questions.last_deleted_at) 
                 OR (assigned_questions.last_assigned_at IS NOT NULL AND assigned_questions.last_deleted_at IS NULL) THEN 'work in progress'
            WHEN assigned_questions.last_assigned_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'assigned but dropped'
            ELSE 'pending'
        END as "status",
        post.created_at,
        post.deleted_at,
        dismissed_questions.dismissed_at,
        assigned_questions.first_assigned_at,
        question_answers.first_answer_created_at as answered_at,
        post.is_anonymous,
        post.user_id,
        assigned_questions.expert_id,
        post.content as question_content, --can we remove html tags from content?
        question_answers.first_answer_content,
        question_answers.first_answer_id,
        rag.total_rag_references,
        rag.unique_rag_docs_referenced,
        rag.list_rag_doc_ids,
        p2p_answers_reviews.invalid_question_do_not_pay,
        p2p_answers_reviews.feedback,
        question_answers.question_url,
        comment_rating.created_at as rated_at, --double check if this is unique on comment_id
        comment_rating.rating,
        comment_rating.additional_information as rating_additional_info,
        dismissed_questions.dismissed_reason,
        dismissed_questions.dismissed_reason_additional_info,
        post_replied_to.test_rag,
        question_answers.count_comments,
        question_answers.count_comments_user,
        question_answers.count_comments_expert,
        subject.id as subject_id, --double check if post_subject is unique on post_id (for type 'subject')
        subject.name as subject_name,
        dim_group_subjects.subject_group_name,
        post_course.subject_id as course_id,
        course.name as course_name,
        institution.id as institution_id,
        institution.name as institution_name,
        institution.country_id as institution_country_id,
        institution.region_code as institution_region_code,
        institution.level as institution_level,
        institution.phase as institution_phase,
        grade.id as grade_id,
        grade.name as grade_name,
        degree.id as degree_id,
        degree.name as degree_name,
        degree.phase as degree_phase,
        country.name as institution_country_name,
        country_tier.tier,
        language.language_geocode as country_language,
        COALESCE(expert_question_views.lifetime_unique_page_views, 0) as lifetime_unique_page_views,
        COALESCE(expert_question_views.lifetime_unique_page_views_seo, 0) as lifetime_unique_page_views_seo,
        COALESCE(expert_question_views.lifetime_total_page_views, 0) as lifetime_total_page_views,
        COALESCE(expert_question_views.lifetime_total_page_views_seo, 0) as lifetime_total_page_views_seo,
        DATEDIFF(minute, post.created_at, assigned_questions.first_assigned_at) as minutes_created_to_assign,
        DATEDIFF(minute, post.created_at, question_answers.first_answer_created_at) as minutes_created_to_answer,
        DATEDIFF(minute, assigned_questions.first_assigned_at, question_answers.first_answer_created_at) as minutes_assign_to_answer,
        DATEDIFF(minute, post.created_at, LEAST(question_answers.first_answer_created_at, dismissed_questions.dismissed_at, post.deleted_at)) as minutes_created_to_resolved
    FROM
        "production"."production_studocu"."post" as post
    LEFT JOIN  
        dismissed_questions 
        ON post.id = dismissed_questions.post_id
    LEFT JOIN   
        assigned_questions
        ON post.id = assigned_questions.post_id
    LEFT JOIN
        question_answers
        ON post.id = question_answers.post_id
    LEFT JOIN
        comment_last_rating as comment_rating
        ON question_answers.first_answer_id = comment_rating.comment_id
    LEFT JOIN 
        "production"."production_studocu"."post_subject" as post_subject
        ON post.id = post_subject.post_id
        AND post_subject.subject_type = 'Subject'
    LEFT JOIN   
        "production"."production_studocu"."subject" as subject
        ON post_subject.subject_id = subject.id
    LEFT JOIN
        "production"."ai_qa"."fact_group_subjects" as fact_group_subjects
        ON post_subject.subject_id = fact_group_subjects.subject_id
    LEFT JOIN
        "production"."ai_qa"."dim_group_subjects" as dim_group_subjects
        ON fact_group_subjects.subject_group_id = dim_group_subjects.subject_group_id
    LEFT JOIN 
        "production"."production_studocu"."post_subject" as post_course
        ON post.id = post_course.post_id
        AND post_course.subject_type = 'Course'
    LEFT JOIN
        "production"."production_studocu"."course" as course
        ON post_course.subject_id = course.id
    LEFT JOIN

        ON post.id = post_institution.post_id

    LEFT JOIN

    LEFT JOIN

model.studocu.int_ai_qa__popular_questio.raw_code:
WITH popular_questions AS (
    SELECT  
        post_views.post_id,
        post_views.course_id,
        post_views.subject_id,
        'POPULAR' as "type",
        COUNT(*) as view_count
    FROM
        {{ ref('stg_metrics_studocu__post_views') }} post_views
    LEFT JOIN
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__post') }} post
        ON post_views.post_id = post.id
    WHERE
        post.type != 'ORGANIC'
    GROUP BY
        1,
        2,
        3,
        4
),
-- Aggreed to order questions that tie on view_count() randomly
random_ranks AS (
    SELECT 
        post_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY course_id ORDER BY RANDOM()) AS random_rank
    FROM 
        popular_questions
),
popular_questions_sorted AS (
    SELECT
        popular_questions.*,
        random_ranks.random_rank
    FROM 
        popular_questions
    INNER JOIN
        random_ranks
        ON popular_questions.post_id = random_ranks.post_id
    ORDER BY
        2,
        5 DESC,
        6
)
SELECT  
    post_id,
    course_id,
    subject_id,
    "type",
    view_count
FROM
    popular_questions_sorted

model.studocu.int_finance__decomposition.raw_code:
with 
    document_view__raw as (
        select 
            dv.distinct_id
            , dv.document_id
            , dv.premium
            , dv.event_datetime as doc_view_datetime
            , dv.mp_country_code as country_geocode
            , c.id as country_id
        from {{ ref('int_content__document_view_minimal') }} as dv 
        inner join {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__country') }} as c on c.geocode = dv.mp_country_code
        where 1 = 1 
            and date_trunc('month', dv.event_datetime) >= '2021-01-01'
    ),
    document_view__agg as (
        select 
            date(date_trunc('month', doc_view_datetime)) as dt
            , country_id 
            , count(distinct distinct_id) as viewing_users
            , count(1) as all_views
            , count(case when premium = 1 then 1 end) as premium_views
        from document_view__raw
        group by 1, 2
        order by 1, 2
    ), 
    payment_started__raw as (
        select 
            distinct_id
            , event_datetime as payment_started_datetime 
            , ps.mp_country_code as country_geocode
            , c.id as country_id 
        from {{ ref('stg_mixpanel__payment_started') }} as ps
        inner join {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__country') }} as c on c.geocode = ps.mp_country_code
        where 1 = 1 
            and date_trunc('month', ps.event_datetime) >= '2021-01-01'
    ), 
    payment_started__agg as (
        select 
            date(date_trunc('month', payment_started_datetime)) as dt
            , country_id 
            , count(distinct distinct_id) as payment_started_users
        from payment_started__raw
        group by 1, 2
        order by 1, 2
    ), 
    subscriptions__raw as (
        select 
            pr.id as subscription_id
            , u.country_id 
            , pr.recurring_interval
            , pr.created_at as first_authorised_payment --trial_started
        from {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__payment_recurring') }} as pr
        left join {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__user') }} as u on u.id = pr.user_id
        where 1 = 1 
            and date_trunc('month', pr.created_at) >= '2021-01-01'
    ),
    payments__raw as (
        select
            subscription_id
            , billing_cycle as recurring_interval
            , country_id
            , min(date) as first_full_payment_date
            , sum(daily_sales_eur_excl_vat) as price_eur 
            , sum(daily_sales_excl_vat) as price_local
        from {{ ref('int_finance__daily_sales') }}
        where 1 = 1
            and payment_recurring_type = 'First payment'
            and daily_sales_eur_excl_vat > 0 
            and subscription_id in (select subscription_id from subscriptions__raw)
        group by 1, 2, 3
    ),
    subscription_payment_joined as (
        select
            sr.subscription_id 
            , sr.country_id
            , sr.recurring_interval
            , sr.first_authorised_payment
            , case when pr.subscription_id is not null then 1 else 0 end as is_converted
            , pr.first_full_payment_date
            , pr.price_eur
            , pr.price_local
        from subscriptions__raw as sr
        left join payments__raw as pr on pr.subscription_id = sr.subscription_id 
    ), 
    subscriptions__agg as (
        select 
            date(date_trunc('month', first_authorised_payment)) as dt 
            , country_id 
            , count(distinct subscription_id) as subscriptions
            , count(distinct case when recurring_interval = 3 then subscription_id end) as quarterly_subs
            , count(distinct case when recurring_interval = 12 then subscription_id end) as annual_subs
            , count(distinct case when is_converted = 1 then subscription_id end) as converted_subs
            , count(distinct case when is_converted = 1 and recurring_interval = 3 then subscription_id end) as converted_quarterly_subs
            , count(distinct case when is_converted = 1 and recurring_interval = 12 then subscription_id end) as converted_annual_subs
        from subscription_payment_joined
        where recurring_interval in (3,12) 
        group by 1, 2
    ),
    payments__agg as (
        select 
            date(date_trunc('month', first_full_payment_date)) as dt 
            , country_id 
            , avg(case when is_converted = 1 and recurring_interval = 3 then price_eur end) as quarterly_price_eur
            , avg(case when is_converted = 1 and recurring_interval = 12 then price_eur end) as annual_price_eur
            , avg(1.0 * price_local / price_eur) as avg_exchange_rate
            , sum(price_eur) as new_sales
        from subscription_payment_joined
        where first_full_payment_date < date_trunc('month', current_date)
        group by 1, 2
    ),
    full_funnel as (
        select 
            date_add('month', 1, t1.dt) as dt 
            , t1.country_id 
            , c.name as country_name
            , ct.tier as country_tier
            ------
            , t1.viewing_users
            , t1.all_views
            , coalesce(cast(t1.premium_views as int), 0) as premium_views
            ------    
            , coalesce(cast(t2.payment_started_users as int), 0) as payment_started_users
            ------
            , coalesce(cast(t3.subscriptions as int), 0) as subscriptions
            , coalesce(cast(t3.quarterly_subs as int), 0) as quarterly_subs
            , coalesce(cast(t3.annual_subs as int), 0) as annual_subs
            -----
            , case when date_add('month', 1, t3.dt) = date_trunc('month', current_date) then null else coalesce(cast(t3.converted_subs as int), 0) end as converted_subs
            , case when date_add('month', 1, t3.dt) = date_trunc('month', current_date) then null else coalesce(cast(t3.converted_quarterly_subs as int), 0) end as converted_quarterly_subs
            , case when date_add('month', 1, t3.dt) = date_trunc('month', current_date) then null else coalesce(cast(t3.converted_annual_subs as int), 0) end as converted_annual_subs

            , cast(round(t4.quarterly_price_eur, 2) as numeric(5, 2)) as quarterly_price_eur
            , cast(round(t4.annual_price_eur, 2) as numeric(5, 2)) as annual_price_eur
            , cast(round(t4.avg_exchange_rate, 3) as numeric(10, 3)) as avg_exchange_rate
            , cast(round(t4.new_sales, 3) as numeric(10, 3)) as new_sales
        from document_view__agg as t1 
        left join payment_started__agg as t2 on t2.dt = t1.dt and t2.country_id = t1.country_id 
        left join subscriptions__agg as t3 on t3.dt = t1.dt and t3.country_id = t1.country_id
        left join payments__agg as t4 on t4.dt = date_add('month', 1, t1.dt) and t4.country_id = t1.country_id
        left join {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__country') }} as c on c.id = t1.country_id
        left join {{ ref('country_tier') }} as ct on ct.country_id = t1.country_id 
        where ct.tier is not null
            and t1.dt >= '2021-01-01' 
            and t1.dt < date_trunc('month', current_date)
        order by 1, 2
    )


select *
from full_funnel

model.studocu.int_finance__user_funnel_w.raw_code:
{{
    config(
        materialized='incremental',
        sort='dt',
    )
}}

with 
    ---***** incremental tables
    raw_document_view as (
        select event_datetime, distinct_id, user_id, document_id, document_view_type, mp_country_code
        from {{ ref('stg_mixpanel__document_view') }} 
        where true
            and event_datetime >= cast('2020-12-28' as date)
        {% if is_incremental() %}
            and date_trunc('week', event_datetime) = date_trunc('week', ('{{ var('logical_date') }}')::timestamp)
        {% endif %}
    ),
    raw_payment_started as (
        select event_datetime, distinct_id 
        from {{ ref('stg_mixpanel__payment_started') }} 
        where true
            and event_datetime >= cast('2020-12-28' as date)
        {% if is_incremental() %}
            and date_trunc('week', event_datetime) = date_trunc('week', ('{{ var('logical_date') }}')::timestamp)
        {% endif %}
    ),
    raw_payment as (
        select p.*, pp.period
        from (
            select id, user_id, created_at, is_trial, event_code, payment_recurring_id, payment_plan_id
            from {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__payment') }}
            where true
                and created_at >= cast('2020-12-28' as date)
                and merchant_reference not like '%REC%'  -- to only take into account the non-recurring payments
            {% if is_incremental() %}
                and date_trunc('week', created_at) = date_trunc('week', ('{{ var('logical_date') }}')::timestamp)
            {% endif %}
        ) p 
        left join {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__payment_plan') }} pp on pp.id = p.payment_plan_id
    ),
    raw_subscription as (
        select id, created_at, user_id
        from {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__payment_recurring') }} 
        where true
            and created_at >= cast('2020-12-28' as date)
        {% if is_incremental() %}
            and date_trunc('week', created_at) = date_trunc('week', ('{{ var('logical_date') }}')::timestamp)
        {% endif %}
    ),
    
    ---***** static tables
    prod_user as (
        select id, institution_id, country_id 
        from {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__user') }}
    ),
    prod_document as (
        select id, institution_id 
        from {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__document') }}
    ),
    prod_institution as (
        select id, country_id, level
        from {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__institution') }}
    ),
    prod_country as (
        select id, geocode, name
        from {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__country') }}
    ),
    user_ids as (
        select user_id, distinct_id 
        from {{ ref('int_content__user_id_distinct_id_mapping') }}
    ),


    --*****************************
    ---***** the query starts here 

    --** top of funnel   
    document_view as (
        select 
            date_trunc('week', event_datetime) as dt
            , distinct_id
            , coalesce(max(user_country_id), max(document_country_id)) as user_country_id
            , max(last_institution_type) as interaction_institution
            , count(1) as views_total 
            , count(case when paywall = 1 then 1 end) as views_paywall
        from (
            select 
                dv.event_datetime 
                , dv.distinct_id
                , dv.user_id 
                , c.id as user_country_id
                , i.country_id as document_country_id
                , case when i.level = 3 then 'High School' else 'University' end as institution_type
                , case when dv.document_view_type != 'Full Document' then 1 else 0 end as paywall
                , last_value(institution_type) over(partition by dv.distinct_id order by dv.event_datetime rows between unbounded preceding and unbounded following) as last_institution_type
            from raw_document_view dv 
            left join prod_document d on d.id = dv.document_id
            left join prod_institution i on i.id = d.institution_id 
            left join prod_country c on c.geocode = dv.mp_country_code
        )
        group by 1, 2
    ),
    payment_started as (
        select
            date_trunc('week', event_datetime) as dt
            , distinct_id
            , 1 as has_payment_started
        from raw_payment_started
        group by 1, 2
    ), 
    tof_user as (
        select 
            dv.dt
            , dv.distinct_id
            , id.user_id
            , coalesce(dv.user_country_id, u.country_id) as country_id
            , case when i.level = 3 then 'High School' else 'University' end as registration_institution
            , coalesce(registration_institution, dv.interaction_institution) as institution_type    -- if user is registered, institution of registration is used, otherwise institution of interaction
            , dv.views_total 
            , dv.views_paywall
            , case when row_number() over(partition by id.user_id order by dv.distinct_id) = 1 then 0 else 1 end duplicate_user_id  -- for each distinct_id, one user_ids will be legit and the rest will be flagged as duplicate
            , ps.has_payment_started
        from document_view dv 
        left join user_ids id on id.distinct_id = dv.distinct_id 
        left join prod_user u on u.id = id.user_id
        left join prod_institution i on i.id = u.institution_id
        left join payment_started ps on ps.dt = dv.dt and ps.distinct_id = dv.distinct_id 
    ),

    --** bottom of funnel
    payment as (
        select 
            date_trunc('week', p1.created_at) as dt
            , p1.user_id
            , count(1) as payment_attempts_before_subscription
            , coalesce(max(case when p1.created_at = p2.first_successul_payment then p1.is_trial::int end), 0) as is_trial
            , max(case when p1.created_at = p2.first_successul_payment then p1.payment_recurring_id end) as subscription_id
            , max(case when p1.created_at = p2.first_successul_payment then period end) as billing_cycle
        from raw_payment p1
        left join (         -- this join is to select all the payments up until the first successul payment
            select user_id, min(created_at) as first_successul_payment 
            from raw_payment
            where event_code = 'AUTHORISATION' 
            group by 1) p2 on p2.user_id = p1.user_id and p1.created_at <= coalesce(p2.first_successul_payment, cast('2100-01-01' as date))     -- all payments before the first sucessful payment
        group by 1, 2
    ),
    subscription as (
        select
            date_trunc('week', created_at) as dt
            , user_id
            , 1 as has_subscription
            , max(id) as subscription_id
        from raw_subscription
        group by 1, 2
    ), 
    bof_user as (
        select 
            p.dt 
            , p.user_id
            , p.payment_attempts_before_subscription
            , p.is_trial
            , coalesce(s.has_subscription, 0) as has_subscription
            , s.subscription_id
            , p.billing_cycle
            , u.country_id
            , case when i.level = 3 then 'High School' else 'University' end as institution_type
        from payment p
        left join subscription s on s.user_id = p.user_id
        left join prod_user u on u.id = p.user_id
        left join prod_institution i on i.id = u.institution_id
    ), 
    
    ----
    funnel as (
        select 
            -- coalesce is used to handle the users that appear in the BOF but not in the TOF
            date(coalesce(tof.dt, bof.dt)) as dt 
            , tof.distinct_id
            , coalesce(tof.user_id, bof.user_id) as user_id
            , coalesce(tof.country_id, bof.country_id) as country_id
            , coalesce(tof.institution_type, bof.institution_type) as institution_type

            , bof.has_subscription

            , case when bof.has_subscription is not null then bof.is_trial end as is_trial
            , bof.billing_cycle
        from tof_user tof
        full outer join bof_user bof on bof.user_id = tof.user_id and tof.duplicate_user_id = 0 -- this is to make sure the payment is attached to only one of the users
    )

model.studocu.int_finance__lifetime_valu.name: int_finance__lifetime_value_retention_cohorts
model.studocu.int_finance__lifetime_valu.raw_code:
with pre_running_subs as (  -- calculating daily revenue earned per subscription to normalize differnt subscription plans (test/ live)
    select
        user_id :: int as user_id,
        subscription_id,
        billing_cycle as period,
        amount_eur_excl_vat / days_until_next_payment as daily_revenue_eur_excl_vat,
        created_at
    from {{ ref('int_finance__daily_recurring_revenue_per_payment') }}
    where subscription_id != 0
    and date_part('year',created_at) >= 2016
),
running_subs as (           -- calculating monthly revenue per subscription per cohort
    select 
        subscription_id,
        period,
        date_trunc('month', min(pre_running_subs.created_at)) as cohort,
        max(user_info.country_id) as country_id,
        count(distinct pre_running_subs.created_at) * period as months_active_sub,
        sum(daily_revenue_eur_excl_vat) as revenue,
        sum(daily_revenue_eur_excl_vat) / (count(distinct pre_running_subs.created_at) * period) as mrr
    from pre_running_subs
    left join {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__user')}}  as user_info on user_info.id = user_id
    where user_info.country_id is not null
    group by 1, 2
),
revenue_per_cohorts as (   -- calcualting total revenue per cohort per country
    select
        country_id,
        period,
        cohort,
        sum(revenue) as total_revenue,
        count(distinct subscription_id) as started_subs_2
    from running_subs
    group by 1, 2, 3
), 

calendar_days as     -- Base table for date ranges 
(
    select 
            distinct trunc(date_trunc('months',"date")) as months
        from 
            {{ ref('stg_general__calendar') }}
        where 
            date_trunc('year',"date") >= 2016

), 

sequence_number as  -- Base table for calculating number of months subscribed
(
    select
        months,  
        row_number() over(order by months) as months_seq
    from  
        calendar_days
),

reverse_months_seq as  -- Base table for filtering values only for past cohorts
(
    select
        months,  
        row_number() over(order by months desc) as reverse_months_seq
    from  
        calendar_days
    where 
        months <= trunc(date_trunc('months', current_date))

), 

monthly_cohorts as   -- calculating active subscriptions per cohort 
(
    select 
        rs.country_id,
        months_seq,
        rs.cohort, 
        rs.period,
        count(distinct rs.subscription_id) as active_subs,
        sum(rs.mrr) as mrr
    from 
        sequence_number 
    cross join running_subs rs
    where months_seq <= rs.months_active_sub
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4

),

ltv_cohorts as (   -- calcualting ltv, retention rate
    select
        monthly_cohorts.country_id,
        monthly_cohorts.period,
        monthly_cohorts.cohort,
        monthly_cohorts.months_seq,
        max(monthly_cohorts.active_subs) over (partition by monthly_cohorts.country_id, monthly_cohorts.cohort, monthly_cohorts.period) as started_subs,
        monthly_cohorts.active_subs,
        1.0 * monthly_cohorts.active_subs / max(monthly_cohorts.active_subs) over (partition by monthly_cohorts.country_id, monthly_cohorts.cohort, monthly_cohorts.period) as retention_rate,
        revenue_per_cohorts.total_revenue,
        monthly_cohorts.mrr,
        monthly_cohorts.mrr / max(monthly_cohorts.active_subs) over (partition by monthly_cohorts.country_id, monthly_cohorts.cohort, monthly_cohorts.period) as ltv
    from monthly_cohorts
    inner join revenue_per_cohorts on revenue_per_cohorts.cohort = monthly_cohorts.cohort 
        and revenue_per_cohorts.period = monthly_cohorts.period
        and revenue_per_cohorts.country_id = monthly_cohorts.country_id
)
select      -- final table bringing all calculated values and filtering the values only for past cohorts
    country.geocode, 
    period as subscription_period, 
    cohort,
    months_seq,
    started_subs, 
    active_subs, 
    retention_rate, 
    total_revenue,
    mrr, 
    ltv,
    sum(mrr) over (partition by country_id, cohort, ltv_cohorts.period order by months_seq rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as cumulative_mrr,
    sum(ltv) over (partition by country_id, cohort, ltv_cohorts.period order by months_seq rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as cumulative_ltv
from ltv_cohorts
left join {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__country')}} as country on country.id = country_id
left join reverse_months_seq on cohort = reverse_months_seq.months
where 
    reverse_months_seq >= months_seq
order by 1, 2, 3, 4

model.studocu.int_finance__user_lifetime.name: int_finance__user_lifetime_value
model.studocu.int_finance__user_lifetime.raw_code:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        churned,
        DATE(MIN(created_at)) AS starting_date,
        DATE(MAX(next_recurrence_at)) AS ending_date,
        COUNT(
            DISTINCT subscription_id
        ) AS subscriptions,
        SUM(successful_payments) AS successful_payments,
        SUM(lifetime_value_eur_incl_vat) AS lifetime_value_eur_incl_vat,
        SUM(lifetime_value_eur_excl_vat) AS lifetime_value_eur_excl_vat
    FROM
        {{ ref('int_payments__all_subscriptions') }}
    WHERE
        is_in_trial = 0
        AND active = TRUE
        AND chargeback = FALSE
    GROUP BY
        1,
        2
)
SELECT
    *,
    DATEDIFF(
        DAY,
        starting_date,
        ending_date
    ) AS lifetime_in_days
FROM
    base

model.studocu.int_finance__warplan.name: int_finance__warplan
model.studocu.int_finance__warplan.raw_code:
with comments as ( 
select 
    institution_id,
    trunc(created_at) as created_at,
    comment_subtype,
    case when comment_subtype = 'EB' then comment -- extra budget
        else NULL end as eb_comment, 
    case when comment_subtype = 'UB' then comment -- uni bucket
        else NULL end as ub_comment,
    case when comment_subtype = 'UC' then comment -- uni comment
        else NULL end as uc_comment
from {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__warplan_institution_comment') }}
where deleted_at is NULL
qualify rank() over (partition by institution_id, comment_subtype order by created_at desc) = 1
),

consolidated_query as 
(
Select
    -- Course doc stats

    coalesce(course_docs.institution_id,0) as institution_id,
    coalesce(course_docs.iname,'NULL') as institution_name,
    course_docs.level as institution_level,
    course_docs.stage  as institution_stage,
    coalesce(course_docs.cid,0) as country_id,
    coalesce(course_docs.cname,'NULL') as country_name,
    coalesce(c_tier.tier,5) as tier,  

    -- Uni bucket 
    case 
        when course_docs.stage = 0 and course_docs.population < 7000 then '0. Non Focus' 
        when course_docs.stage = 0 and (paid_docs_published+organic_docs) > 300 then '0. Grew Organically'
        when course_docs.course_total < 150 and course_docs.stage = 0 and course_docs.population >= 7000 then '0. Find Curricula'
        when course_docs.course_total >= 150 and course_docs.stage = 0 and course_docs.population > 7000 then '1. Ready for Launch'
        when course_docs.stage = 1 and (((paid_docs_published+organic_docs) < 1100 and paid_docs_published < 800) or paid_docs_published <950) then '2. Buy'
        when pe.total_docs_payout_extra_eur is not NULL then '3. Buy Extra'
        when course_docs.stage = 1 then '4. Boost or Wait'
            when course_docs.stage > 1 and (paid_docs_published+organic_docs) between 1000 and 1500 then '5. Tipped >1000'
            when course_docs.stage > 1 and (paid_docs_published+organic_docs) between 1500 and 2000 then '6. Tipped >1500'
            when course_docs.stage > 1 and (paid_docs_published+organic_docs) >= 2000 then '7. Tipped >2000'
            else '8. Other' end as bucket, 
    case 
        when len(cub.ub_comment) > 0 then cub.ub_comment
        else NULL end as uni_bucket,

    -- Course doc stats

    coalesce(course_docs.factor,0) as factor,
    coalesce(course_docs."population",0) as "population",
    coalesce(course_docs.course_total,0) as course_total,
    coalesce(course_docs.courses_docs,0) as courses_docs,
    coalesce(course_docs.organic_docs,0) as organic_docs,
    coalesce(course_docs.paid_docs_potential,0) as paid_docs_potential,
    coalesce(course_docs.paid_docs_published,0) as paid_docs_published,
    coalesce(course_docs.staff_docs_published,0) as staff_docs_published,
    coalesce(course_docs.organic_docs_jul17,0) as organic_docs_jul17,
    coalesce(course_docs.paid_docs_potential_jul17,0) as paid_docs_potential_jul17,
    coalesce(course_docs.paid_docs_published_jul17,0) as paid_docs_published_jul17,
    coalesce(course_docs.staff_docs_published_jul17,0) as staff_docs_published_jul17,

    -- Payouts & Payout extras
    case 
        when pt.total_doc_payout_eur is NULL then 0 
        else pt.total_doc_payout_eur end as docs_payout_extra_eur,
    case 
        when len(ceb.eb_comment) > 0 then ceb.eb_comment
        else NULL end as extra_budget,
    case 
        when course_docs.stage <= 1 and ceb.eb_comment is NULL and (950 - (paid_docs_published))*3 > 0 then ((950 - (paid_docs_published))*3)
        when course_docs.stage <= 1 and pe.total_docs_payout_extra_eur < 1.0*(ceb.eb_comment :: FLOAT) then (1.0*(ceb.eb_comment :: FLOAT) - (pe.total_docs_payout_extra_eur :: FLOAT))
        else 0 end as remaining_investment, 

    -- Uni stage change 
    case when ceb.eb_comment is not NULL and course_docs.stage = 1 and (coalesce(pe.total_docs_payout_extra_eur,0) :: FLOAT) > 0.8*1.0*(ceb.eb_comment:: FLOAT) then 'EB_to_EB_or_2'
        when ceb.eb_comment is NULL and course_docs.stage = 1 and (((paid_docs_published+organic_docs) >= 1100 and paid_docs_published >= 800) or paid_docs_published >=950) then '1_to_EB_or_2'
        else NULL end as status_changes,

    -- Institution Stats
    coalesce(institution_stats.days_phase1,0) as days_phase1 ,
    0 as docs_paid_L7D,
    0 as docs_paid_L30D,
    0 as docs_paid_L180D,
    coalesce(institution_stats.docs_total,0) as docs_total,
    coalesce(institution_stats.docs_paid_total,0) as docs_paid_total,
    coalesce(institution_stats.lecture_notes,0) as lecture_notes,
    coalesce(institution_stats.exams,0) as exams,
    coalesce(institution_stats.summaries,0) as summaries,
    coalesce(institution_stats.assignments,0) as assignments,
    coalesce(institution_stats.essays,0) as essays,
    coalesce(institution_stats.lecture_notes_perct,0) as lecture_notes_perct,
    coalesce(institution_stats.exams_perct,0) as exams_perct,
    coalesce(institution_stats.summaries_perct,0) as summaries_perct,
    coalesce(institution_stats.assignments_perct,0) as assignments_perct,
    coalesce(institution_stats.essays_perct,0) as essays_perct,
    coalesce(institution_stats.unique_uploaders,0) as unique_uploaders,
    coalesce(institution_stats.ratings_number,0) as ratings_number,
    coalesce(institution_stats.rating_score,0) as rating_score,
    coalesce(institution_stats.courses_total,0) as courses_total,
    coalesce(institution_stats.courses_above_5_docs,0) as courses_above_5_docs,
    coalesce(institution_stats.courses_above_10_docs,0) as courses_above_10_docs,
    coalesce(institution_stats.courses_above_20_docs,0) as courses_above_20_docs,
    coalesce(institution_stats.courses_above_5_docs_perct,0) as courses_above_5_docs_perct,
    coalesce(institution_stats.courses_above_10_docs_perct,0) as courses_above_10_docs_perct,
    coalesce(institution_stats.courses_above_20_docs_perct,0) as courses_above_20_docs_perct,

    -- Uni comments 
    case 
        when cuc.uc_comment is NULL then '' 
        else cuc.uc_comment end as uni_comment,

    -- DAU 
    coalesce(local_dau.max_local_daus_30d,0) as max_local_daus_30d,

    --Uploader 
    coalesce(uploaders.max_uploaders_l30d,0) as max_uploaders_l30d,

    --Document view
    coalesce(unique_doc_view.unique_dv_l90d,0) as unique_dv_l90d,
    coalesce(unique_doc_view.unique_dv_l90d_ly,0) as unique_dv_l90d_ly,
    coalesce(unique_doc_view.unique_dv_l90d_yoy,0) as unique_dv_l90d_yoy,

    -- Course view 
    coalesce(unique_course_view.unique_cv_l90d,0) as unique_cv_l90d,
    coalesce(unique_course_view.unique_cv_l90d_ly,0) as unique_cv_l90d_ly,
    coalesce(unique_course_view.unique_cv_l90d_yoy,0) as unique_cv_l90d_yoy,

    -- Sales 
    coalesce(sales.yearly_sales_eur,0) as yearly_sales_eur,
    coalesce(sales.yearly_sales_ly_eur,0) as yearly_sales_ly_eur,
    coalesce(sales.sales_yoy,0) as sales_yoy,
    coalesce(sales.subscribers,0) as subscribers,
    coalesce(sales.subscribers_ly,0) as subscribers_ly,
    coalesce(sales.subscribers_yoy,0) as subscribers_yoy
    
from  {{ ref('int_product__institution_course_docs') }} as course_docs
left join {{ ref('country_tier') }} as c_tier on c_tier.country_id = course_docs.cid
left join {{ ref('int_finance__institution_total_payout') }} as pt on pt.institution_id = course_docs.institution_id
left join {{ ref('int_finance__institution_payout_extra') }} as pe on pe.institution_id = course_docs.institution_id
left join comments as ceb on ceb.institution_id = course_docs.institution_id and ceb.comment_subtype = 'EB'
left join comments as cub on cub.institution_id = course_docs.institution_id and cub.comment_subtype = 'UB'
left join comments as cuc on cuc.institution_id = course_docs.institution_id and cuc.comment_subtype = 'UC'
left join {{ ref('int_product__institution_stage1_stats') }} as institution_stats on institution_stats.institution_id = course_docs.institution_id
left join {{ ref('int_product__institution_local_dau_30d') }} as local_dau on local_dau.institution_id = course_docs.institution_id
left join {{ ref('int_product__institution_uploaders_30d') }} as uploaders on uploaders.institution_id = course_docs.institution_id
left join {{ ref('int_product__unique_doc_view_l90d') }} as unique_doc_view on unique_doc_view.institution_id = course_docs.institution_id
left join {{ ref('int_product__unique_course_view_l90d') }} as unique_course_view on unique_course_view.institution_id = course_docs.institution_id
left join {{ ref('int_finance__subscription_sales_yoy') }} as sales on sales.institution_id = course_docs.institution_id 
order by 
    1 
)

select * from consolidated_query order by 1

        when course_docs.stage = 0 and (paid_docs_published+organic_docs) > 300 then '0. Grew Organically'
        when course_docs.course_total < 150 and course_docs.stage = 0 and course_docs.population >= 7000 then '0. Find Curricula'
        when course_docs.course_total >= 150 and course_docs.stage = 0 and course_docs.population > 7000 then '1. Ready for Launch'
        when course_docs.stage = 1 and (((paid_docs_published+organic_docs) < 1100 and paid_docs_published < 800) or paid_docs_published <950) then '2. Buy'
        when pe.total_docs_payout_extra_eur is not NULL then '3. Buy Extra'
        when course_docs.stage = 1 then '4. Boost or Wait'
            when course_docs.stage > 1 and (paid_docs_published+organic_docs) between 1000 and 1500 then '5. Tipped >1000'
            when course_docs.stage > 1 and (paid_docs_published+organic_docs) between 1500 and 2000 then '6. Tipped >1500'
            when course_docs.stage > 1 and (paid_docs_published+organic_docs) >= 2000 then '7. Tipped >2000'
            else '8. Other' end as bucket, 
    case 
        when len(cub.ub_comment) > 0 then cub.ub_comment
        else NULL end as uni_bucket,

    -- Course doc stats

    coalesce(course_docs.factor,0) as factor,
    coalesce(course_docs."population",0) as "population",
    coalesce(course_docs.course_total,0) as course_total,
    coalesce(course_docs.courses_docs,0) as courses_docs,
    coalesce(course_docs.organic_docs,0) as organic_docs,
    coalesce(course_docs.paid_docs_potential,0) as paid_docs_potential,
    coalesce(course_docs.paid_docs_published,0) as paid_docs_published,
    coalesce(course_docs.staff_docs_published,0) as staff_docs_published,
    coalesce(course_docs.organic_docs_jul17,0) as organic_docs_jul17,
    coalesce(course_docs.paid_docs_potential_jul17,0) as paid_docs_potential_jul17,
    coalesce(course_docs.paid_docs_published_jul17,0) as paid_docs_published_jul17,
    coalesce(course_docs.staff_docs_published_jul17,0) as staff_docs_published_jul17,

    -- Payouts & Payout extras
    case 
        when pt.total_doc_payout_eur is NULL then 0 
        else pt.total_doc_payout_eur end as docs_payout_extra_eur,
    case 
        when len(ceb.eb_comment) > 0 then ceb.eb_comment
        else NULL end as extra_budget,
    case 
        when course_docs.stage <= 1 and ceb.eb_comment is NULL and (950 - (paid_docs_published))*3 > 0 then ((950 - (paid_docs_published))*3)
        when course_docs.stage <= 1 and pe.total_docs_payout_extra_eur < 1.0*(ceb.eb_comment :: FLOAT) then (1.0*(ceb.eb_comment :: FLOAT) - (pe.total_docs_payout_extra_eur :: FLOAT))
        else 0 end as remaining_investment, 

    -- Uni stage change 
    case when ceb.eb_comment is not NULL and course_docs.stage = 1 and (coalesce(pe.total_docs_payout_extra_eur,0) :: FLOAT) > 0.8*1.0*(ceb.eb_comment:: FLOAT) then 'EB_to_EB_or_2'
        when ceb.eb_comment is NULL and course_docs.stage = 1 and (((paid_docs_published+organic_docs) >= 1100 and paid_docs_published >= 800) or paid_docs_published >=950) then '1_to_EB_or_2'
        else NULL end as status_changes,

    -- Institution Stats
    coalesce(institution_stats.days_phase1,0) as days_phase1 ,
    0 as docs_paid_L7D,
    0 as docs_paid_L30D,
    0 as docs_paid_L180D,
    coalesce(institution_stats.docs_total,0) as docs_total,
    coalesce(institution_stats.docs_paid_total,0) as docs_paid_total,
    coalesce(institution_stats.lecture_notes,0) as lecture_notes,
    coalesce(institution_stats.exams,0) as exams,
    coalesce(institution_stats.summaries,0) as summaries,
    coalesce(institution_stats.assignments,0) as assignments,
    coalesce(institution_stats.essays,0) as essays,
    coalesce(institution_stats.lecture_notes_perct,0) as lecture_notes_perct,
    coalesce(institution_stats.exams_perct,0) as exams_perct,
    coalesce(institution_stats.summaries_perct,0) as summaries_perct,
    coalesce(institution_stats.assignments_perct,0) as assignments_perct,
    coalesce(institution_stats.essays_perct,0) as essays_perct,
    coalesce(institution_stats.unique_uploaders,0) as unique_uploaders,
    coalesce(institution_stats.ratings_number,0) as ratings_number,
    coalesce(institution_stats.rating_score,0) as rating_score,
    coalesce(institution_stats.courses_total,0) as courses_total,
    coalesce(institution_stats.courses_above_5_docs,0) as courses_above_5_docs,
    coalesce(institution_stats.courses_above_10_docs,0) as courses_above_10_docs,
    coalesce(institution_stats.courses_above_20_docs,0) as courses_above_20_docs,
    coalesce(institution_stats.courses_above_5_docs_perct,0) as courses_above_5_docs_perct,
    coalesce(institution_stats.courses_above_10_docs_perct,0) as courses_above_10_docs_perct,
    coalesce(institution_stats.courses_above_20_docs_perct,0) as courses_above_20_docs_perct,

    -- Uni comments 
    case 
        when cuc.uc_comment is NULL then '' 
        else cuc.uc_comment end as uni_comment,

    -- DAU 
    coalesce(local_dau.max_local_daus_30d,0) as max_local_daus_30d,

    --Uploader 
    coalesce(uploaders.max_uploaders_l30d,0) as max_uploaders_l30d,

    --Document view
    coalesce(unique_doc_view.unique_dv_l90d,0) as unique_dv_l90d,
    coalesce(unique_doc_view.unique_dv_l90d_ly,0) as unique_dv_l90d_ly,
    coalesce(unique_doc_view.unique_dv_l90d_yoy,0) as unique_dv_l90d_yoy,

    -- Course view 
    coalesce(unique_course_view.unique_cv_l90d,0) as unique_cv_l90d,
    coalesce(unique_course_view.unique_cv_l90d_ly,0) as unique_cv_l90d_ly,
    coalesce(unique_course_view.unique_cv_l90d_yoy,0) as unique_cv_l90d_yoy,

    -- Sales 
    coalesce(sales.yearly_sales_eur,0) as yearly_sales_eur,
    coalesce(sales.yearly_sales_ly_eur,0) as yearly_sales_ly_eur,
    coalesce(sales.sales_yoy,0) as sales_yoy,
    coalesce(sales.subscribers,0) as subscribers,
    coalesce(sales.subscribers_ly,0) as subscribers_ly,
    coalesce(sales.subscribers_yoy,0) as subscribers_yoy
    
from  "production"."intermediate"."int_product__institution_course_docs" as course_docs
left join "raw_data"."general"."country_tier" as c_tier on c_tier.country_id = course_docs.cid
left join "production"."intermediate"."int_finance__institution_total_payout" as pt on pt.institution_id = course_docs.institution_id
left join "production"."intermediate"."int_finance__institution_payout_extra" as pe on pe.institution_id = course_docs.institution_id
left join comments as ceb on ceb.institution_id = course_docs.institution_id and ceb.comment_subtype = 'EB'
left join comments as cub on cub.institution_id = course_docs.institution_id and cub.comment_subtype = 'UB'
left join comments as cuc on cuc.institution_id = course_docs.institution_id and cuc.comment_subtype = 'UC'
left join "production"."intermediate"."int_product__institution_stage1_stats" as institution_stats on institution_stats.institution_id = course_docs.institution_id
left join "production"."intermediate"."int_product__institution_local_dau_30d" as local_dau on local_dau.institution_id = course_docs.institution_id
left join "production"."intermediate"."int_product__institution_uploaders_30d" as uploaders on uploaders.institution_id = course_docs.institution_id
left join "production"."intermediate"."int_product__unique_doc_view_l90d" as unique_doc_view on unique_doc_view.institution_id = course_docs.institution_id
left join "production"."intermediate"."int_product__unique_course_view_l90d" as unique_course_view on unique_course_view.institution_id = course_docs.institution_id
left join "production"."intermediate"."int_finance__subscription_sales_yoy" as sales on sales.institution_id = course_docs.institution_id 
order by 
    1 
)

model.studocu.int_finance__decomposition.name: int_finance__decomposition_existing_sales
model.studocu.int_finance__decomposition.raw_code:
with 
    finance as (
        select 
            ds.subscription_id
            , ds.country_id 
            , c.name as country_name
            , ct.tier as country_tier
            , 1.0 * ds.daily_sales_excl_vat / ds.daily_sales_eur_excl_vat as exchange_rate
            , ds.billing_cycle 
            , ds.date as payment_date 
            , ds.daily_sales_eur_excl_vat as sales_eur 
            , rank() over(partition by ds.subscription_id order by ds.date) as payment_rank
            , date(date_add('month', ds.billing_cycle, date_trunc('day', payment_date))) as next_payment_date
            , payment_rank + 1 as next_payment_rank
        from {{ ref('int_finance__daily_sales') }} as ds
        left join {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__institution' )}} as i on i.id = ds.university_id
        left join {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__country')}} as c on c.id = ds.country_id
        left join {{ ref('country_tier') }} as ct on ct.country_id = c.id
        where ds.subscription_id != 0
            and ds.billing_cycle in (3,12)
            and ds.daily_sales_eur_excl_vat > 0
    ), 
    expected as (
        select 
            date(date_trunc('month', next_payment_date)) as dt
            , country_id 
            , country_name
            , country_tier
            , billing_cycle
            , next_payment_rank
            , count(distinct subscription_id) as expected_pays
        from finance
        group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
    ), 
    actual as (
        select 
            date(date_trunc('month', payment_date)) as dt
            , country_id 
            , country_name
            , country_tier
            , billing_cycle
            , payment_rank
            , count(distinct subscription_id) as actual_pays
            , 1.0 * sum(sales_eur) / count(distinct subscription_id) as price_eur
            , round(avg(exchange_rate), 3) as avg_exchange_rate
            , sum(sales_eur) as actual_sales
        from finance
        where payment_rank > 1 
        group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
    ),
    final as (
        select 
            ep.dt
            , ep.country_id
            , ep.country_name
            , ep.country_tier
            , ep.billing_cycle
            , ep.next_payment_rank as nth_payment
            , ep.expected_pays 
            , coalesce(ap.actual_pays, 0) as actual_pays
            , cast(round(ap.price_eur, 2) as numeric(5, 2)) as price_eur
            , cast(round(ap.avg_exchange_rate, 3) as numeric(10, 3)) as avg_exchange_rate
            , cast(round(ap.actual_sales, 2) as numeric(10, 2)) as actual_sales
        from expected as ep
        left join actual as ap on ap.dt = ep.dt and ap.country_id = ep.country_id and ap.billing_cycle = ep.billing_cycle and ap.payment_rank = ep.next_payment_rank
        where ep.dt >= '2021-01-01' and ep.dt < date_trunc('month', current_date)
            and ep.country_tier is not null 
        order by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
    )

select *
from final

model.studocu.int_finance__subscription_.name: int_finance__subscription_sales_yoy
model.studocu.int_finance__subscription_.raw_code:
with mrr_table as 
(
    select
        trunc(mrr.created_at) as created_at,
        mrr.university_id as institution_id,
        user_id as subscribers,
        amount_eur_excl_vat AS sales_eur_excl_vat
    from {{ref('int_payments__successful_non_trial_payments')}} as mrr
    where trunc(mrr.created_at) >= trunc(dateadd(day,-455, current_date))
   
),

yearly_metrics as
(
    select 
        institution_id,
        sum(case when trunc(created_at) between trunc(dateadd(day,-90, current_date)) and trunc(current_date) then sales_eur_excl_vat end)/90*365 as yearly_sales_eur,
        sum(case when trunc(created_at) between trunc(dateadd(day,-455, current_date)) and trunc(dateadd(day,-365, current_date)) then sales_eur_excl_vat end)/90*365 as yearly_sales_ly_eur, 
        count( distinct case when  trunc(created_at) between trunc(dateadd(day,-90, current_date)) and trunc(current_date) then subscribers end) as subscribers,
        count( distinct case when  trunc(created_at) between trunc(dateadd(day,-455, current_date)) and trunc(dateadd(day,-365, current_date)) then subscribers end) as subscribers_ly
    from mrr_table
    group by 1
    order by 1
)
select
    institution_id,
    yearly_sales_eur,
    yearly_sales_ly_eur, 
    case when yearly_sales_ly_eur > 0  
        then (1.0*yearly_sales_eur/yearly_sales_ly_eur) - 1 end as sales_yoy, 
    subscribers, 
    subscribers_ly,
    case when subscribers_ly > 0  
        then (1.0*subscribers/subscribers_ly) - 1 end as subscribers_yoy
from 
    yearly_metrics

model.studocu.int_finance__consolidated_.name: int_finance__consolidated_lifetime_value_retention_cohorts
model.studocu.int_finance__consolidated_.raw_code:
with pre_running_subs as (
    select
        user_id :: int as user_id,
        subscription_id,
        billing_cycle as period,
        amount_eur_excl_vat / days_until_next_payment as daily_revenue_eur_excl_vat,
        created_at
    from {{ ref('int_finance__daily_recurring_revenue_per_payment') }}
    where subscription_id != 0
    and date_part('year',created_at) >= 2016
),
running_subs as ( 
    select 
        subscription_id,
        period,
        date_trunc('month', min(pre_running_subs.created_at)) as cohort,
        count(distinct pre_running_subs.created_at) * period as months_active_sub,
        sum(daily_revenue_eur_excl_vat) as revenue,
        sum(daily_revenue_eur_excl_vat) / (count(distinct pre_running_subs.created_at) * period) as mrr
    from pre_running_subs
    group by 1, 2
),
revenue_per_cohorts as (
    select
        period,
        cohort,
        sum(revenue) as total_revenue,
        count(distinct subscription_id) as started_subs_2
    from running_subs
    group by 1, 2
), 

calendar_days as 
(
    select 
            distinct trunc(date_trunc('months',"date")) as months
        from 
            {{ ref('stg_general__calendar') }}
        where 
            date_trunc('year',"date") >= 2016

), 

sequence_number as 
(
    select
        months,  
        row_number() over(order by months) as months_seq
    from  
        calendar_days
),

reverse_months_seq as 
(
    select
        months,  
        row_number() over(order by months desc) as reverse_months_seq
    from  
        calendar_days
    where 
        months <= trunc(date_trunc('months', current_date))

), 

monthly_cohorts as 
(
    select 
        months_seq,
        rs.cohort, 
        rs.period,
        count(distinct rs.subscription_id) as active_subs,
        sum(rs.mrr) as mrr
    from 
        sequence_number 
    cross join running_subs rs
    where months_seq <= rs.months_active_sub
    group by 1, 2, 3

),

ltv_cohorts as (
    select
        monthly_cohorts.period,
        monthly_cohorts.cohort,
        monthly_cohorts.months_seq,
        max(monthly_cohorts.active_subs) over (partition by monthly_cohorts.cohort, monthly_cohorts.period) as started_subs,
        monthly_cohorts.active_subs,
        1.0 * monthly_cohorts.active_subs / max(monthly_cohorts.active_subs) over (partition by monthly_cohorts.cohort, monthly_cohorts.period) as retention_rate,
        revenue_per_cohorts.total_revenue,
        monthly_cohorts.mrr,
        monthly_cohorts.mrr / max(monthly_cohorts.active_subs) over (partition by monthly_cohorts.cohort, monthly_cohorts.period) as ltv
    from monthly_cohorts
    inner join revenue_per_cohorts on revenue_per_cohorts.cohort = monthly_cohorts.cohort 
        and revenue_per_cohorts.period = monthly_cohorts.period
)
select
    'ALL' as geocode,
    period as subscription_period, 
    cohort,
    months_seq,
    started_subs, 
    active_subs, 
    retention_rate, 
    total_revenue,
    mrr, 
    ltv,
    sum(mrr) over (partition by cohort, ltv_cohorts.period order by months_seq rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as cumulative_mrr,
    sum(ltv) over (partition by cohort, ltv_cohorts.period order by months_seq rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as cumulative_ltv
from ltv_cohorts
left join reverse_months_seq on cohort = reverse_months_seq.months
where 
    reverse_months_seq >= months_seq
order by 1, 2, 3, 4

group by 1
),

    select 
        uni.merged_into_id as merged_into_id,
        sum(amount_eur) as docs_payout_eur
from {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__payout')}} p
inner join {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__institution')}} uni on uni.id = p.institution_id
where p.status in ('SUCCESS') 
    and uni.merged_into_id is not null
   
group by 1
)

select 
    uni.institution_id,
    uni.docs_payout_eur + coalesce(merged_uni.docs_payout_eur,0) as total_doc_payout_eur
from 
    payout_data as uni
left join 
    payout_data_merged_uni as merged_uni on merged_uni.merged_into_id = uni.institution_id

model.studocu.int_payments__all_subscrip.name: int_payments__all_subscriptions
model.studocu.int_payments__all_subscrip.raw_code:
WITH subscriptions AS (
    SELECT
        pr.id AS subscription_id,
        pr.created_at,
        pr.user_id,
        pr.next_recurrence_at,
        pr.last_recurrence_at,
        pr.paused_until,
        pr.merchant_reference,
        pr.recurring_detail_reference,
        pr.payment_plan_id,
        pr.recurring_interval AS billing_cycle,
        pr.active,
        pr.merchant_account,
        pr.brand_code AS payment_method,
        pr.is_recharged_insufficient_funds,
        pr.refund,
        pr.chargeback,
        pr.payments,
        pr.is_in_trial,
        pr.cancelled_at,
        CASE
            WHEN pr.cancelled_at IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS churned,
        pr.started_at,
        country.id AS country_id,
        country.geocode,
        institution.id AS university_id
    FROM
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__payment_recurring') }} AS pr
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__user') }} AS "user"
        ON "user".id = pr.user_id
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__country') }} AS country
        ON country.id = "user".country_id
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__institution') }} AS institution
        ON institution.id = "user".institution_id
),
successful_payments_per_subscription AS (
    SELECT
        subscription_id,
        COUNT(
            DISTINCT payment_id
        ) AS successful_payments,
        SUM(
            amount_eur_incl_vat
        ) AS lifetime_value_eur_incl_vat,
        SUM(amount_eur_excl_vat / (1 + tax)) AS lifetime_value_eur_excl_vat
    FROM
        {{ ref('int_payments__successful_non_trial_payments') }}
    GROUP BY
        1
)
SELECT
    subscriptions.*,
    sp.successful_payments,
    sp.lifetime_value_eur_incl_vat,
    sp.lifetime_value_eur_excl_vat,
    {# Using the next recurring payment date as ending date until the next payment #}
    DATEDIFF(
        DAY,
        subscriptions.created_at,
        subscriptions.next_recurrence_at
    ) AS lifetime_in_days,
    DATEDIFF(
        MONTH,
        subscriptions.created_at,
        subscriptions.next_recurrence_at
    ) AS lifetime_in_months
FROM
    subscriptions
LEFT JOIN successful_payments_per_subscription AS sp
    ON sp.subscription_id = subscriptions.subscription_id

model.studocu.int_payments__all_payments.name: int_payments__all_payments
model.studocu.int_payments__all_payments.raw_code:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        payment.id AS payment_id,
        payment.merchant_reference,
        payment.psp_reference,
        payment.user_id AS user_id,
        payment.payment_recurring_id AS subscription_id,
        payment.created_at,
        DATEADD(
            'month',
            payment_plan.period,
            payment.created_at
        ) AS next_payment_at,
        DATEDIFF(
            DAY,
            payment.created_at,
            DATEADD(
                'month',
                payment_plan.period,
                payment.created_at
            )
        ) AS days_until_next_payment,
        payment.event_code AS payment_status,
        payment.is_trial,
        payment.recurring,
        payment.brand_code AS payment_method,
        payment_plan.period AS billing_cycle,
        payment_plan.price,
        payment_plan.surcharge,
        country.id AS country_id,
        country.geocode,
        "user".institution_id AS university_id,
        payment.currency,
        exchange_rate.symbol,
        exchange_rate.eur_rate,
        payment.tax,
        payment.amount / 100.0 AS amount_incl_vat,
        payment.amount / 100.0 / (
            1 + payment.tax
        ) AS amount_excl_vat,
        payment.amount / 100.0 / exchange_rate.eur_rate AS amount_eur_incl_vat,
        payment.amount / 100.0 / exchange_rate.eur_rate / (
            1 + payment.tax
        ) AS amount_eur_excl_vat
    FROM
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__payment') }} AS payment
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__payment_plan') }} AS payment_plan
        ON payment.payment_plan_id = payment_plan.id
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__payment_recurring') }} AS payment_recurring
        ON payment.payment_recurring_id = payment_recurring.id
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__user') }} AS "user"
        ON payment.user_id = "user".id
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__country') }} AS country
        ON "user".country_id = country.id
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_general__exchange_rate') }} AS exchange_rate
        ON CAST(
            payment.created_at AS DATE
        ) = exchange_rate.date
        AND payment.currency = exchange_rate.currency
)
SELECT
    *
FROM
    base

model.studocu.int_payments__successful_n.name: int_payments__successful_non_trial_payments
model.studocu.int_payments__successful_n.raw_code:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() over (
            PARTITION BY subscription_id
            ORDER BY
                created_at
        ) AS subscription_payment_order
    FROM
        {{ ref('int_payments__all_payments') }}
    WHERE
        payment_status IN {{ var('successful_event_code') }}
        AND is_trial = 0
)
SELECT
    *,
    CASE
        WHEN subscription_payment_order = 1 THEN 'First payment'
        ELSE 'Recurring payment'
    END AS payment_recurring_type
FROM
    base

all_activity AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(activation_started.date, 
                 account_activation.date,
                 course_views.date,

                 login_complete.date,
                 registration_started.date,
                 registration_complete.date,
                 expert_entry_point_clicked.date) as date,
        COALESCE(activation_started.user_id, 
                 account_activation.user_id,
                 course_views.user_id,
                 extensive_search_triggered.user_id,
                 search_result_clicked.user_id,
                 search_result_clicked.user_id,
                 courses_followed.user_id,
