model.studocu.stg_customer_io__deliverie.description: Deliveries are individual Email, push, SMS, slack, and webhook records sent from your workspace.

workspace_id.name: workspace_id
workspace_id.description: The ID of the Customer.io workspace associated with the delivery record.

delivery_id.name: delivery_id
delivery_id.description: The ID of the delivery record.

internal_customer_id.name: internal_customer_id
internal_customer_id.description: The cio_id of the person in question. Use the people parquet file to resolve this ID to an external customer_id or email address.

subject_id.name: subject_id
subject_id.description: If the delivery was created as part of a Campaign or API Triggered Broadcast workflow, this is the ID for the path the person went through in the workflow. Note: This value refers to, and is the same as, the subject_name in the subjects table.

event_id.name: event_id
event_id.description: If the delivery was created as part of an event-triggered Campaign, this is the ID for the unique event that triggered the workflow.

delivery_type.name: delivery_type
delivery_type.description: The type of delivery: email, push, in-app, sms, slack, or webhook.

campaign_id.name: campaign_id

model.studocu.stg_customer_io__people.raw_code:
{{
    config(
        tags=['PII']
    )
}}
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        workspace_id :: INTEGER as workspace_id,	
        customer_id :: VARCHAR as customer_id,	
        internal_customer_id :: VARCHAR as internal_customer_id,	
        deleted :: BOOLEAN as deleted,	
        suppressed :: BOOLEAN as suppressed,	
        created_at :: TIMESTAMP as created_at,	
        updated_at :: TIMESTAMP as updated_at,	
        {{ sensitive_nullify("email_addr::VARCHAR") }} as email_addr,
        workspace :: VARCHAR as workspace
    FROM
        {{ source(
            'datalake_customer_io',
            'people'
        ) }}
    {% if is_incremental() %}

        WHERE
            created_at::DATE = date('{{ var('logical_date') }}')
    {% endif %}
),
last_records as (
    SELECT 
        *
    FROM
        base b
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, customer_id ORDER BY updated_at DESC) = 1
),
first_records AS (
    SELECT 
        *
    FROM
        base b
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, customer_id ORDER BY updated_at ASC) = 1
),
remove_duplicates as (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        base.workspace_id,
        base.workspace,
        base.customer_id,
        first_records.internal_customer_id,
        first_records.email_addr,
        last_records.deleted,
        last_records.suppressed,
        first_records.created_at,
        last_records.updated_at
    FROM
        base
    INNER JOIN
        first_records
        ON base.workspace_id = first_records.workspace_id
        AND base.customer_id = first_records.customer_id
    INNER JOIN
        last_records
        ON base.workspace_id = last_records.workspace_id
        AND base.customer_id = last_records.customer_id
)
SELECT
    *
FROM
    remove_duplicates

model.studocu.stg_facebook_ads__ad_sets.raw_code:
WITH source AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() over (
            PARTITION BY id
            ORDER BY
                updated_time DESC
        ) AS latest_updated
    FROM
        {{ source(
            'facebook_ads',
            'ad_set_history'
        ) }}
),
latest AS (
    SELECT
        *
    FROM
        source
    WHERE
        latest_updated = 1
),
{# Keep only active non-deleted university #}
active_universities AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        "name",
        phase,
        country_id
    FROM
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__institution') }}
    WHERE
        deleted = 0
        AND merged_into_id IS NULL
),
transformed AS (
    SELECT
        latest.*,
        COALESCE(
            institution.id,
            institution_2.id
        ) AS university_id,
        COALESCE(
            institution.phase,
            institution_2.phase
        ) AS stage
    FROM
        latest
        LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_facebook_ads__campaigns') }} AS campaigns
        ON campaigns.id = latest.campaign_id
        LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__country') }} AS country
        ON country.geocode = campaigns.geocode
        LEFT JOIN active_universities AS institution
        ON institution.id = REGEXP_SUBSTR(
            latest.name,
            '([0-9])*'
        ) 
        {# extract the first numeric characters before reaching a different character type #}
        AND institution.country_id = country.id
        LEFT JOIN active_universities AS institution_2
        ON institution_2.name = latest.name
        AND institution_2.country_id = country.id
)
SELECT
    *
FROM
    transformed

model.studocu.stg_facebook_ads__campaign.raw_code:
WITH source AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() over (
            PARTITION BY id
            ORDER BY
                updated_time DESC
        ) AS latest_updated
    FROM
        {{ source(
            'facebook_ads',
            'campaign_history'
        ) }}
),
latest AS (
    SELECT
        *
    FROM
        source
    WHERE
        latest_updated = 1
),
transformed AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        UPPER(
            CASE
                WHEN name NOT LIKE 'Document Buying%' THEN SUBSTRING(
                    name,
                    4,
                    2
                )
                WHEN name LIKE 'Document Buying%' AND SUBSTRING(REPLACE(name, 'Document Buying | ', ''), 1, 2) LIKE 'UK' THEN 'GB'
                WHEN name LIKE 'Document Buying%' THEN SUBSTRING(REPLACE(name, 'Document Buying | ', ''), 1, 2)                
            END
        ) AS campaign_country
    FROM
        latest
),
joins AS (
    SELECT
        transformed.*,
        country.geocode,
        country_tier.tier
    FROM
        transformed
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__country') }} AS country
        ON country.geocode = transformed.campaign_country
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('country_tier') }} AS country_tier
        ON country_tier.country_id = country.id
)
SELECT
    *
FROM
    joins

model.studocu.stg_facebook_ads__creative.name: stg_facebook_ads__creatives
model.studocu.stg_facebook_ads__creative.raw_code:
WITH source AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() over (
            PARTITION BY id
            ORDER BY
                _fivetran_synced DESC
        ) AS latest_updated
    FROM
        {{ source(
            'facebook_ads',
            'creative_history'
        ) }}
),
generator AS (
    SELECT
        number AS generated_number
    FROM
        {{ ref('generated_numbers') }}
),
flattened_url_tags AS (
    SELECT
        source.id AS creative_id,
        json_extract_array_element_text(
            source.url_tags,
            GENERATOR.generated_number :: INT - 1,
            TRUE
        ) AS element
    FROM
        source
        INNER JOIN GENERATOR
        ON json_array_length(
            source.url_tags
        ) >= generator.generated_number
    WHERE 
        latest_updated = 1
),
extracted_fields AS (
    SELECT
        creative_id,
        json_extract_path_text(
            element,
            'key'
        ) AS key,
        json_extract_path_text(
            element,
            'value'
        ) AS value
    FROM
        flattened_url_tags
),
pivot_table AS (
    SELECT
        creative_id,
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN key = 'utm_source' THEN value
            END
        ) AS utm_source,
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN key = 'utm_medium' THEN value
            END
        ) AS utm_medium,
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN key = 'utm_campaign' THEN value
            END
        ) AS utm_campaign,
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN key = 'utm_term' THEN value
            END
        ) AS utm_term,
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN key = 'utm_content' THEN value
            END
        ) AS utm_content
    FROM
        extracted_fields
    GROUP BY
        creative_id
),
all_fields AS (
    SELECT
        source.*,
        pivot_table.*,        
        replace({{ clean_url('source.page_link') }}, 'https://', '') AS base_url
    FROM
        source
    LEFT JOIN pivot_table
        ON pivot_table.creative_id = source.id 
), urls as (
    SELECT
        *,
        SPLIT_PART(base_url, '/', 1) as url_host,
        REPLACE(
            base_url, 
            SPLIT_PART(base_url, '/', 1),
            ''
        ) as url_path        
    FROM
        all_fields
)
SELECT
    *
FROM
    urls

model.studocu.stg_ai_qa__p2p_answers_rev.name: stg_ai_qa__p2p_answers_reviews
model.studocu.stg_ai_qa__p2p_answers_rev.description: This table serves as the main working table for the P2P quality process. It is used to manually verify answers by P2P Experts. The source is a [gsheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1JWHNzKG-LlsrLP7PucTFUnZvIFZ5tuqhjmxDMJlSenQ/edit?pli=1#gid=1229836917) that is maintained manually by the Q&A team.

agent.name: agent
agent.description: An identifier of the Studocu agent that verified the question (their first name)

review_date.name: review_date
review_date.description: The date on which the agent verified the question (starts on Monday)

review_week.name: review_week
review_week.description: The week number in which the agent verified the question

review_month.name: review_month
review_month.description: The month in which the agent verified the question

created_date.name: created_date
created_date.description: The date on which the question was answered (including timestamp)

created_week.name: created_week
created_week.description: The week in which the question was answered (starts on Monday)

expert_id.name: expert_id
expert_id.description: The unique idenitifier for the expert answering the question

question_id.name: question_id
question_id.description: The unique identifier of the question

rating.name: rating
rating.description: The rating received by the expert for their answer from the user asking the question. It can be 1, -1 or NULL.

additional_info.name: additional_info
additional_info.description: The reply received by the expert from the user

url.name: url
url.description: Direct link to the question, based on the unique question_id

characters_per_min.name: characters_per_min
characters_per_min.description: How many characters per minute the expert inputted between the time they had started answering the question (i.e. assigned the question to themselves) and the time they finished (i.e. clicked submit)

assigned_to_finished.name: assigned_to_finished
assigned_to_finished.description: How many minutes the expert spent on answering a question, from when they started answering the question (i.e. assigned the question to themselves) and the time they finished (i.e. clicked submit)

question_rank_per_expert.name: question_rank_per_expert
question_rank_per_expert.description: Incremental count for each time an expert answers a question within a week. I.e. for 10 answers in a week, the oldest answer has a value of 1, the newest answer of 10.

sort_by_z_a.name: sort_by_z_a
sort_by_z_a.description: Allocates a value from 0 to 100% to the question, based on a custom prioritization for quality  checks

total_answers.name: total_answers
total_answers.description: Total number of answers an expert has provided since November 2022 until the present day

invalid_questions.name: invalid_questions
invalid_questions.description: Total number of questions that we did not pay the expert for, due to quality concerns

invalid_question_rate.name: invalid_question_rate
invalid_question_rate.description: Total number of questions that we did not pay the expert for divided by the total answers the expert answered so far

percentage_plagiarized.name: percentage_plagiarized
percentage_plagiarized.description: A manual input based on a plagiarism check through a third party platform (plagiarismcheck.org). It goes from 0% (default) to 100%.

status.name: status
status.description: A manually inputted verdict on the experts answer, from our agents. There are multiple options (its a dynamic field).

invalid_question_do_not_pay.name: invalid_question_do_not_pay
invalid_question_do_not_pay.description: Manually inputted field from our agents to define whether we pay the expert for an answer or not. Two options - 0 (pay for the answer), 1 (do not pay for the answer).

plagiarized_link_or_duplicated_question_.name: plagiarized_link_or_duplicated_question_id
plagiarized_link_or_duplicated_question_.description: Contributes to the feedback column, together with the template column. It is either empty, has a question_id (in the case of a duplicate question) or a link (in the case of plagiarized content). Manual input.

feedback.name: feedback

model.studocu.stg_google_ads__ads.name: stg_google_ads__ads
model.studocu.stg_google_ads__ads.raw_code:
WITH source AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() over (
            PARTITION BY id
            ORDER BY
                updated_at DESC
        ) AS latest_updated
    FROM
        {{ source(
            'google_ads',
            'ad_history'
        ) }}
), 
latest AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        {# Remove [ and ] from colum #}
        REPLACE(REPLACE(final_urls, '[', ''), ']', '') AS landing_page_url
    FROM
        source
    WHERE
        latest_updated = 1
),
urls AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        {# keep only character before ? and remove trailing https:// #}
        REPLACE({{ clean_url('landing_page_url') }}, 'https://', '') AS base_url
    FROM
        latest),
utms AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        {# Keep domain only #}
        SPLIT_PART(
            base_url,
            '/',
            1
        ) AS url_host,
        {# Remove domain #}
        REPLACE(
            base_url,
            SPLIT_PART(
                base_url,
                '/',
                1
            ),
            ''
        ) AS url_path,
        {{ dbt_utils.get_url_parameter(
            'landing_page_url',
            'utm_source'
        ) }} AS utm_source,
        {{ dbt_utils.get_url_parameter(
            'landing_page_url',
            'utm_medium'
        ) }} AS utm_medium,
        {{ dbt_utils.get_url_parameter(
            'landing_page_url',
            'utm_campaign'
        ) }} AS utm_campaign,
        {{ dbt_utils.get_url_parameter(
            'landing_page_url',
            'utm_term'
        ) }} AS utm_term,
        {{ dbt_utils.get_url_parameter(
            'landing_page_url',
            'utm_content'
        ) }} AS utm_content
        FROM
            urls
    )
SELECT
    *
FROM
    utms

WITH source AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() over (
            PARTITION BY id
            ORDER BY
                updated_at DESC
        ) AS latest_updated
    FROM
        {{ source(
            'google_ads',
            'campaign_history'
        ) }}
),
latest AS (
    SELECT
        *
    FROM
        source
    WHERE
        latest_updated = 1
),
transformed AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        UPPER(
            CASE
                WHEN name NOT LIKE 'Document Buying%' THEN SUBSTRING(name,4,2)
            END
        ) AS campaign_country
    FROM
        latest
),
joins AS (
    SELECT
        transformed.*,
        country.geocode,
        country_tier.tier
    FROM
        transformed
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__country') }} AS country
        ON country.geocode = transformed.campaign_country
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('country_tier') }} AS country_tier
        ON country_tier.country_id = country.id
)
SELECT
    *
FROM
    joins

model.studocu.stg_production_studocu__pa.raw_code:
{{ config(
    sort='created_at'
) }}
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        "payment"."id",
        timestamp 'epoch' + "payment"."created" * interval '1 second' AS "created_at", 
        "payment"."user_id",
        "payment"."payment_plan_id",
        "payment"."psp_reference",
        "payment"."merchant_reference",
        "payment"."amount",
        "payment"."brand_code",
        "payment"."payment_method_id",
        "payment"."shopper_locale",
        "payment"."currency",
        "payment"."event_code",
        "payment"."recurring",
        "payment"."merchant_account",
        "payment"."is_recharged_insufficient_funds",
        CASE WHEN is_recharged_insufficient_funds THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END AS is_recharged_insufficient_funds_string,
        CASE    -- timestamp is 1st of January
            WHEN "institution"."state_id" = 66 THEN COALESCE("payment"."tax", 0.0)
            WHEN "institution"."state_id" IS NULL THEN COALESCE("payment"."tax", 0.0)
            WHEN "payment"."created" >= 1704063600 AND "payment"."country_id" = 10 AND "institution"."country_id" = 10 AND "user"."country_id" = 10 AND "payment"."currency" = 'USD' THEN COALESCE("tax"."tax_rate", 0)  
            WHEN "payment"."created" >= 1704063600 AND "payment"."country_id" = 9 AND "institution"."country_id" = 9 AND "user"."country_id" = 9 AND "payment"."currency" = 'CAD' THEN COALESCE("tax"."tax_rate", 0)
            ELSE COALESCE("payment"."tax", 0.0)
        END AS tax,
        "payment"."custom_link_id",
        "payment"."is_trial",
        "payment"."method_change",
        CASE WHEN is_trial THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END AS is_trial_string,
        "payment"."payment_recurring_id",
        "payment"."trial_days",
        "payment"."country_id",
        "institution"."state_id"
    FROM {{ source('rds_production_studocu','payment') }} AS "payment"
    LEFT JOIN {{ source('rds_production_studocu','user') }} AS "user" ON "user"."id" = "payment"."user_id"
    LEFT JOIN {{ source('rds_production_studocu','institution') }} AS "institution" ON "institution"."id" = "user"."institution_id"
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_general__state_tax_rates') }} AS "tax" ON "tax"."country_id" = "user"."country_id" AND "tax"."state_id" = "institution"."state_id"
)


SELECT
    *,
    {{ dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key([
        'id',
        'created_at',
        'user_id',
        'payment_plan_id',
        'psp_reference',
        'merchant_reference',
        'amount',
        'brand_code',
        'payment_method_id',
        'shopper_locale',
        'currency',
        'event_code',
        'recurring',
        'merchant_account',
        'is_recharged_insufficient_funds_string',
        'tax',
        'custom_link_id',
        'is_trial_string',
        'payment_recurring_id',
        'trial_days',
        'country_id'
    ]) }} AS etl_md5
FROM
    base

model.studocu.stg_production_studocu__ac.name: stg_production_studocu__acquisition_batch_group
model.studocu.stg_production_studocu__ac.description: This table contains information on paid acquisition batch groups. An acquisition batch groups is a collection of acquisition batches uploaded by the same user, and collectively handled by the ops agent. See [this miro board](https://miro.com/app/board/uXjVOBImwKU=/) for a visualisation of the paid uploader flow.  See [this miro board](https://miro.com/app/board/uXjVOrh-P7Y=/) for a visualisation of the offer processing flow. A batch group can be countered or voided. Countering means that the automatically calculated offer price is countered by an ops agent.  An offer can be voided if one or more documents in the uploaded batches are flagged as problematic (e.g. due to copyright issues, or being duplicate documents). This table should be (left) joined to production_studocu.acquisition_batch_group_counter_reason and production_studocu.acquisition_batch_group_voiding_reason to pick up those instances. These tables themselves are linked to production_studocu.counter_reason and production_studocu.voiding_reasons.

id.name: id
id.description: Unique acquisition batch group identifier

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.description: Date on which the batch group was created

updated_at.name: updated_at
updated_at.description: Date on which the offer last changed status (e.g. `is_on_hold`, `reason_id`, `amount`, etc. changing)

currency.name: currency
currency.description: Local currency of the grouped offers (based on the provided payment information).  If a group has multiple batches in different currencies, the currency will be set to EUR.

amount.name: amount
amount.description: Payment amount for the total batch group in local currency of the uploader (and the sum of `total_offer` of all `acquisition_batch`es  in a group)

amount_eur.name: amount_eur
amount_eur.description: Payment amount for the total batch group in euros (and the sum of `total_offer_euro` of all `acquisition_batch`es  in a group)

admin_id.name: admin_id
admin_id.description: The user_id of the ops agent who has handled the review and processing

paid.name: paid
paid.description: Whether or not the payment has been made

model.studocu.stg_production_studocu__ac.raw_code:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        "id",
        {{ from_unixtime("created_at") }} as created_at,
        {{ from_unixtime("updated_at") }} as updated_at,            
        "user_id",
        "currency",
        "amount",
        "amount_eur",
        "admin_id",
        "paid"
        --"is_on_hold",
        --"voided"     
    FROM
        {{ source(
            'rds_production_studocu',
            'acquisition_batch_group'
        ) }} 
)
SELECT
    *
FROM
    base

Whether or not the user is a super uploader.

An user is a super uploader if:
 - she is verified 
 - she is not blocklisted,
 - she has uploaded more than 5 and no more than 500 documents
 - she has uploaded at least 1 one document within the last year
 - she has a minimum of 25 upvotes combined and a ratings score of > 50% (upvotes / (upvotes+downvotes))
 - her institution and country are within tier 1-3
 - her ip address matches the user's institution country and is within our focus countries (Tier 1-3)
 - her institution is in stage 1 or 2

{{
    config(
        dist='institution_id'
    )
}}
WITH source AS (
    SELECT 
        DISTINCT
        cs.subject_id AS institution_id,
        c.created_at,
        CASE WHEN c.comment LIKE 'UB_%' THEN 'UB'
            WHEN c.comment LIKE 'EB_%' THEN 'EB'
            WHEN c.comment LIKE 'UC_%' THEN 'UC'
        END AS comment_subtype,
        CASE WHEN c.comment LIKE 'UB_%' THEN replace(c.comment,'UB_','')
            WHEN c.comment LIKE 'EB_%' THEN replace(c.comment,'EB_','')
            WHEN c.comment LIKE 'UC_%' THEN replace(c.comment,'UC_','')
        END AS comment,
        c.deleted_at
    FROM {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__comment') }} AS c
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__comment_subject') }} AS cs ON cs.comment_id = c.id AND cs.subject_type = 'Institution'
     WHERE c.comment LIKE 'UB_%' OR c.comment LIKE 'EB_%' OR c.comment LIKE 'UC_%'
),
converted AS (
    SELECT
        "institution_id" :: INTEGER AS "institution_id",
        "created_at" :: TIMESTAMP AS "created_at",
        "comment_subtype" ::VARCHAR AS "comment_subtype",
        "comment" ::VARCHAR AS "comment",
        "deleted_at" :: TIMESTAMP AS "deleted_at"
    FROM
        source
)
SELECT
    *
FROM
    converted

        currency.id AS currency_id,
        currency.code AS currency,
        currency.symbol,
        AVG(
            exchange_rate.rate
        ) AS eur_rate
    FROM
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__exchange_rate') }} AS exchange_rate
        LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__currency') }} AS currency
        ON currency.id = exchange_rate.currency_id
    GROUP BY
        1,
        2,
        3,
        4
),
currencies AS (
    SELECT
        DISTINCT currency_id
    FROM
        exchange_rate
),
dates AS (
    SELECT
        calendar."date",
        currencies.currency_id
    FROM
        {{ ref('stg_general__calendar') }} AS calendar
        CROSS JOIN currencies
    GROUP BY
        1,
        2
),
moving_average_rates AS (
    SELECT
        dates.date,
        dates.currency_id,
        LAST_VALUE(
            exchange_rate.currency ignore nulls
        ) over (
            PARTITION BY dates.currency_id
            ORDER BY
                dates.date rows BETWEEN unbounded preceding
                AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS currency,
        LAST_VALUE(
            exchange_rate.symbol ignore nulls
        ) over (
            PARTITION BY dates.currency_id
            ORDER BY
                dates.date rows BETWEEN unbounded preceding
                AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS symbol,
        COALESCE(
            exchange_rate.eur_rate,
            AVG(
                exchange_rate.eur_rate ignore nulls
            ) over (
                PARTITION BY dates.currency_id
                ORDER BY
                    dates.date rows BETWEEN 5 preceding
                    AND 5 following
            )
        ) AS eur_rate
    FROM
        dates
        LEFT JOIN exchange_rate
        ON exchange_rate.date_of_exchange_rate = dates.date
        AND exchange_rate.currency_id = dates.currency_id
)
SELECT
    dates.date,
    'EUR' AS currency,
    '€' AS symbol,
    1 AS eur_rate
FROM
    dates
GROUP BY
    1,
    2,
    3,
    4
UNION ALL
SELECT
    moving_average_rates.date,
    moving_average_rates.currency,
    moving_average_rates.symbol,
    moving_average_rates.eur_rate
FROM
    moving_average_rates
GROUP BY
    1,
    2,
    3, 
    4

model.studocu.groups__messages_metadata.raw_code:
with

user_first_message as (
select
    user_id,
    min(created_at) as first_message_ts
from {{ref('stg_production_studocu__chat_message')}}
where deleted_at is null
group by 1
),

messages_same_group as (
select
    cm1.id as chat_message_id,
    min(case when cm2.created_at > cm1.created_at then cm2.created_at end) as chat_prev_messaged_at,
    max(case when cm2.created_at < cm1.created_at then cm2.created_at end) as chat_next_messaged_at
from {{ref('stg_production_studocu__chat_message')}} cm1
left join {{ref('stg_production_studocu__chat_message')}} cm2
    on  cm1.chat_group_id = cm2.chat_group_id
    and cm1.user_id <> cm2.user_id
    and cm2.deleted_at is null
where cm1.deleted_at is null
group by 1
),

messages_same_user as (
select
    cm1.id as chat_message_id,
    min(case when cm2.created_at > cm1.created_at then cm2.created_at end) as user_prev_messaged_at,
    max(case when cm2.created_at < cm1.created_at then cm2.created_at end) as user_next_messaged_at
from {{ref('stg_production_studocu__chat_message')}} cm1
left join {{ref('stg_production_studocu__chat_message')}} cm2
    on  cm1.user_id = cm2.user_id
    and cm2.created_at not between cm1.created_at - interval '24h' and cm1.created_at + interval '24h'
    and cm2.deleted_at is null
where cm1.deleted_at is null
group by 1
)

select
    cm.id as chat_message_id,
    cm.user_id,
    cm.chat_group_id,
    cm.parent_id,
    cm.content,
    cm.created_at,
    cm.updated_at,
    cm.deleted_at,
    case when cm.chat_group_id = 2 or cm.deleted_at is null or u.email like '%studocu%' then 0 else 1 
        end as is_valid_message,
    u.email user_email,
    u.created_at as user_created_at,
    u.country_id as user_country_id,
    u.institution_id as user_institution_id,
    ui.name as user_institution_name,
    ui.level as user_institution_level,
    cg.name as chat_group_name,
    cg.created_at as chat_group_created_at,
    cg.deleted_at as chat_group_deleted_at,
    cg.user_id as chat_group_creator_id,
    case when cg.chattable_type = 'Course' and (ci.level = 3 or deg.id is not null) then 'Course-HS' 
         when cg.chattable_type = 'Course' then 'Course-UNI' 
         when cgui.level =  3 then 'Custom-HS'
         when cgui.level <> 3 then 'Custom-UNI'
         else 'Oher'
         end
        as chat_group_type,
    cg.channel_id,
    cg.chattable_type,
    cg.chattable_id,
    cg.description as chat_group_description,
    cg.country_id as chat_group_country_id,
    cgc.name as chat_group_country_name,
    cgct.tier as chat_group_country_tier,
    cgu.email as chat_group_creator_email,
    cgu.created_at as chat_group_creator_created_at,
    cgu.country_id as chat_group_creator_country_id,
    cgu.institution_id as chat_group_creator_institution_id,
    cgui.name as chat_group_creator_institution_name,
    cgui.level as chat_group_creator_institution_level,
    c.id as course_id,
    c.name as course_name,
    c.code as course_code,
    c.active as course_active,
    c.deleted_at as course_deleted_at,
    c.merged_into_id as course_merged_into_id,
    c.region_code as course_region_code,
    c.country_id as course_country_id,
    c.institution_id as course_institution_id,
    ci.name as course_institution_name,
    ci.level as course_institution_level,
    g.id as course_grade_id,
    g.name as course_grade_name,
    deg.id as course_degree_id,
    deg.name as course_degree_name,
    case when first_message_ts is not null then 1 else 0 
        end as is_user_first_message,
    msg.chat_prev_messaged_at,
    msg.chat_next_messaged_at,
    msu.user_prev_messaged_at,
    msu.user_next_messaged_at
from {{ref('stg_production_studocu__chat_message')}} cm
left join {{ref('stg_production_studocu__user')}} u
    on cm.user_id = u.id
left join {{ref('stg_production_studocu__institution')}} ui
    on u.institution_id = ui.id
left join {{ref('stg_production_studocu__chat_group')}} cg
    on cm.chat_group_id = cg.id
left join {{ref('stg_production_studocu__country')}} cgc
    on cg.country_id = cgc.id
left join {{ref('country_tier')}} cgct
    on cg.country_id = cgct.country_id
left join {{ref('stg_production_studocu__user')}} cgu
    on cg.user_id = cgu.id
left join {{ref('stg_production_studocu__institution')}} cgui
    on cgu.institution_id = cgui.id
left join {{ref('stg_production_studocu__course')}} c
    on  cg.chattable_type = 'Course'
    and cg.chattable_id = c.id
left join {{ref('stg_production_studocu__institution')}} ci
    on c.institution_id = ci.id
left join {{ref('stg_production_studocu__grade')}} g
    on c.grade_id = g.id
left join {{ref('stg_production_studocu__degree')}} deg
    on coalesce(c.degree_id,g.degree_id) = deg.id
left join user_first_message ufm
    on  cm.user_id = ufm.user_id
    and cm.created_at = ufm.first_message_ts
left join messages_same_group msg 
    on cm.id = msg.chat_message_id
left join messages_same_user msu 
    on cm.id = msu.chat_message_id

model.studocu.customer_support__zendesk_.name: customer_support__zendesk_tickets
model.studocu.customer_support__zendesk_.description: This table contains ticket-level information of Zendesk tickets handled by customer support and the ops team. Each record in this table corresponds to a unique ticket.

ticket_id.name: ticket_id
ticket_id.description: Unique identifier of a Zendesk ticket

requester_id.name: requester_id
requester_id.description: Unique Zendesk-specific identifier of the student who has raised the ticket

studocu_requester_id.name: studocu_requester_id
studocu_requester_id.description: Unique Studocu-specific identifier of the student who has raised the ticket

first_assignee_id.name: first_assignee_id
first_assignee_id.description: Unique Zendesk-specific identifier of the admin or agent who was first assigned the ticket

first_studocu_assignee_id.name: first_studocu_assignee_id
first_studocu_assignee_id.description: Unique Studocu-specific identifier of the admin or agent who was first assigned the ticket

last_assignee_id.name: last_assignee_id
last_assignee_id.description: Unique Zendesk-specific identifier of the admin or agent who was last assigned the ticket

last_studocu_assignee_id.name: last_studocu_assignee_id
last_studocu_assignee_id.description: Unique Studocu-specific identifier of the admin or agent who was last assigned the ticket

group.name: group
group.description: The workstream to which the ticket belongs (e.g. Support, GDPR, Copyright, PoE, etc.)

priority.name: priority
priority.description: The priority status of the ticket (e.g. normal, low, urgent, etc.)

type.name: type
type.description: The type of the ticket, and one of problem, incident, or taks (or NULL)

first_tag.name: first_tag
first_tag.description: The first tag given to the ticket by the first assigned agent or admin

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.description: Date and time on which the ticket was first created (status = "new")

assigned_at.name: assigned_at
assigned_at.description: Date and time on which the ticket was first assigned, if ever (status = "open")

first_response_at.name: first_response_at
first_response_at.description: Date and time on which the ticket was first responded to by an agent (technically, the date and time of the first public comment)

last_response_at.name: last_response_at
last_response_at.description: Date and time on which the ticket was last responded to by an agent (technically, the date and time of the last public comment)

first_solved_at.name: first_solved_at
first_solved_at.description: Date and time on which the ticket was first solved, if ever (status = "solved")

last_solved_at.name: last_solved_at
last_solved_at.description: Date and time on which the ticket was last solved, if ever (status = "solved")

closed_at.name: closed_at
closed_at.description: Date and time on which the ticket was last closed, if ever (status = "closed")

first_response.name: first_response
first_response.description: The first (public) response from an agent or admin on the ticket to the requester

last_response.name: last_response
last_response.description: The last (public) response from an agent or admin on the ticket to the requester

total_responses.name: total_responses
total_responses.description: The total number of responses by agents or admins on the ticket (so far)

total_requester_messages.name: total_requester_messages
total_requester_messages.description: The total number of messages sent by the (end) user (so far)

current_status.name: current_status
current_status.description: The most recent status of the ticket

last_satisfaction_score.name: last_satisfaction_score
last_satisfaction_score.description: The latest satisfaction score assigned by the request to the last handling agent, and one of "good", "bad" or "offered"

last_satisfaction_reason.name: last_satisfaction_reason
last_satisfaction_reason.description: The reason provided for the last satisfaction score by the requester

sla_breach_time.description: The time at which the SLA on first response time will be breached (typically 9 hours after the creation date) - this does NOT take into account business hours

sla_breached.name: sla_breached
sla_breached.description: A binary flagging if the first response time SLA on a ticket has been breached

merged_into_id.name: merged_into_id
merged_into_id.description: The id of the ticket into which this ticket was merged (if any)

model.studocu.customer_support__zendesk_.raw_code:
SELECT
    ticket.ticket_id,
    ticket.requester_id,
    studocu_user.id AS studocu_requester_id,
    assignees.first_assignee_id,
    assignees.first_studocu_assignee_id,
    assignees.last_assignee_id,
    assignees.last_studocu_assignee_id,
    ticket.name AS "group",
    ticket.type,
    ticket.priority,
    zendesk_tags.first_tag,
    ticket.created_at,
    states.assigned_at,
    responses.first_response_at,
    responses.last_response_at,
    states.first_solved_at,
    states.last_solved_at,
    states.closed_at,
    responses.first_response,
    responses.last_response,
    responses.total_responses,
    responses.total_requester_messages,
    ticket.status AS current_status, 
    rating.score AS last_satisfaction_score,
    rating.reason AS last_satisfaction_reason,
    dateadd(min, COALESCE(sla.sla_target_in_minutes, 540), ticket.created_at::timestamp) AS sla_breach_time,
    case 
        when responses.first_response_at is null and dateadd(min, COALESCE(sla.sla_target_in_minutes, 540), ticket.created_at::timestamp) < dateadd(hr, 2, getdate()) then 1
        when responses.first_response_at > sla_breach_time then 1
        else 0
    end as sla_breached,
    merged_tickets.merged_into_id
FROM
    {{ ref('int_zendesk__customer_support_tickets') }} AS ticket
LEFT JOIN
    {{ ref('int_zendesk__ticket_assignees') }} AS assignees
    ON ticket.ticket_id = assignees.ticket_id
LEFT JOIN
    {{ ref('int_zendesk__ticket_tags') }} AS zendesk_tags
    ON ticket.ticket_id = zendesk_tags.ticket_id
LEFT JOIN   
    {{ ref('int_zendesk__ticket_states') }} AS states
    ON ticket.ticket_id = states.ticket_id
LEFT JOIN
    {{ ref('int_zendesk__ticket_responses') }} AS responses
    ON ticket.ticket_id = responses.ticket_id
LEFT JOIN
    {{ ref('int_zendesk__ticket_ratings') }} AS rating
    ON ticket.ticket_id = rating.ticket_id
    AND assignees.last_assignee_id = rating.assignee_id
LEFT JOIN
    {{ ref('int_zendesk__ticket_current_sla_policy') }} AS sla
    ON ticket.ticket_id = sla.ticket_id
    AND ticket.priority = sla.priority
LEFT JOIN
    {{ ref('stg_zendesk__user') }} AS zendesk_user
    ON ticket.requester_id = zendesk_user.id
LEFT JOIN
    {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__user') }} AS studocu_user
    ON zendesk_user.email = studocu_user.email
LEFT JOIN
    {{ ref('int_zendesk__merged_tickets') }} AS merged_tickets
    on ticket.ticket_id = merged_tickets.ticket_id

model.studocu.finance__lifetime_value_co.raw_code:
WITH cohorts AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC(
            'MONTH',
            created_at
        ) AS starting_month,
        DATE_TRUNC(
            'MONTH',
            next_recurrence_at
        ) AS ending_month,
        "user_id",
        billing_cycle,
        {{ billing_cycle('billing_cycle')}} as billing_cycle_name,
        country_id,
        geocode,
        university_id,
        COUNT(
            DISTINCT subscription_id
        ) AS subscriptions,
        SUM(lifetime_value_eur_incl_vat) AS lifetime_value_eur_incl_vat,
        SUM(lifetime_value_eur_excl_vat) AS lifetime_value_eur_excl_vat
    FROM
        {{ ref('int_payments__all_subscriptions') }}
    GROUP BY
        1,
        2,
        3,
        4,
        5,
        6,
        7,
        8
),
monthly_lifetime_value AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC(
            'MONTH',
            calendar.date
        ) AS "month",
        cohorts.billing_cycle,
        cohorts.country_id,
        cohorts.geocode,
        cohorts.university_id,
        SUM(subscriptions) AS total_subscriptions,
        SUM(lifetime_value_eur_incl_vat) AS lifetime_value_eur_incl_vat,
        SUM(lifetime_value_eur_excl_vat) AS lifetime_value_eur_excl_vat
    FROM
        {{ ref('stg_general__calendar') }} AS calendar
        LEFT JOIN cohorts
        ON DATE_TRUNC(
            'MONTH',
            calendar.date
        ) BETWEEN cohorts.starting_month
        AND cohorts.ending_month
    GROUP BY
        1,
        2,
        3,
        4,
        5
)
SELECT
    *
FROM
    monthly_lifetime_value

model.studocu.finance__sales_decompositi.raw_code:
with 
    new_sales_raw as (
        select * 
        from {{ ref('int_finance__decomposition_new_sales') }}
    ), 
    new_sales as (
        select 
            dt
            , country_id
            , country_name 
            , country_tier
            , viewing_users
            , all_views
            , premium_views
            , payment_started_users
            , subscriptions
            , quarterly_subs
            , converted_quarterly_subs
            , quarterly_price_eur
            , annual_subs
            , converted_annual_subs
            , annual_price_eur
            , new_sales as sales_from_new_subs
            , avg_exchange_rate
        from new_sales_raw
    ), 
    existing_sales_raw as (
        select 
            dt
            , country_id
            , country_name 
            , country_tier 
            , coalesce(sum(case when billing_cycle = 3 then expected_pays end), 0) as quarterly_expected_pays
            , coalesce(sum(case when billing_cycle = 3 then actual_pays end), 0) as quarterly_actual_pays
            , coalesce(avg(case when billing_cycle = 3 then price_eur end), 0) as quarterly_price_eur
            , coalesce(sum(case when billing_cycle = 12 then expected_pays end), 0) as annual_expected_pays
            , coalesce(sum(case when billing_cycle = 12 then actual_pays end), 0) as annual_actual_pays
            , coalesce(avg(case when billing_cycle = 12 then price_eur end), 0) as annual_price_eur
            , avg(avg_exchange_rate) as avg_exchange_rate
            , sum(actual_sales) as total_existing_sales
        from {{ ref('int_finance__decomposition_existing_sales') }}
        group by 1, 2, 3, 4
    ), 
    existing_sales as (
        select
            dt
            , country_id
            , country_name 
            , country_tier 
            , quarterly_expected_pays
            , quarterly_actual_pays
            , quarterly_price_eur
            , round(quarterly_actual_pays * quarterly_price_eur, 2) as quarterly_renewal_sales
            , annual_expected_pays
            , annual_actual_pays
            , annual_price_eur
            , round(annual_actual_pays * annual_price_eur, 2) as annual_renewal_sales 
            , total_existing_sales as sales_from_existing_subs
            , avg_exchange_rate
        from existing_sales_raw
    ), 
    final as (
        select 
            n.dt
            , n.country_id
            , n.country_name
            , n.country_tier
            , n.viewing_users
            , n.all_views
            , n.premium_views
            , n.payment_started_users
            , n.subscriptions
            , n.quarterly_subs
            , n.converted_quarterly_subs
            , n.quarterly_price_eur as quarterly_price_eur_new
            , n.annual_subs
            , n.converted_annual_subs
            , n.annual_price_eur as annual_price_eur_new
            , n.sales_from_new_subs      
            , e.quarterly_expected_pays
            , e.quarterly_actual_pays
            , e.quarterly_price_eur as quarterly_price_eur_existing
            , e.annual_expected_pays
            , e.annual_actual_pays
            , e.annual_price_eur as annual_price_eur_existing
            , e.sales_from_existing_subs
            , coalesce(n.sales_from_new_subs, 0) + coalesce(e.sales_from_existing_subs, 0) as total_sales
            , coalesce(n.avg_exchange_rate, e.avg_exchange_rate) as avg_exchange_rate
        from new_sales n
        left join existing_sales e on e.dt = n.dt and e.country_id = n.country_id
        where 1 = 1
            and n.country_name not in {{ var('banned_country_names') }}
    )

select *
from final 
order by 1, 2

model.studocu.finance__daily_recurring_r.raw_code:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        "date",
        payment_id,
        subscription_id,
        "user_id",
        university_id,
        country_id,
        geocode,
        billing_cycle,
        {{ billing_cycle('billing_cycle')}} as billing_cycle_name,
        payment_method,
        payment_recurring_type,
        amount_incl_vat AS price,
        amount_eur_incl_vat AS price_eur,
        currency,
        eur_rate AS exchange_eur_rate,
        SUM(
            amount_incl_vat / days_until_next_payment
        ) AS daily_revenue_incl_vat,
        SUM(
            amount_excl_vat / days_until_next_payment
        ) AS daily_revenue_excl_vat,
        SUM(
            amount_eur_incl_vat / days_until_next_payment
        ) AS daily_revenue_eur_incl_vat,
        SUM(
            amount_eur_excl_vat / days_until_next_payment
        ) AS daily_revenue_eur_excl_vat
    FROM
        {{ ref('int_finance__daily_recurring_revenue_per_payment') }}
        {{ dbt_utils.group_by(15) }}
)
SELECT
    *,
    {{ dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key([
        'date',
        'payment_id',
        'subscription_id',
        'user_id',
        'university_id',
        'country_id',
        'geocode',
        'billing_cycle_name',
        'payment_method',
        'payment_recurring_type'
    ]) }} AS etl_md5,
    {{ dates_dimensions('date') }}
FROM
    base

model.studocu.finance__revenue_per_docum.raw_code:
WITH user_ltv_shares_per_document AS (
    SELECT
        reads.user_id,
        user_ltv.lifetime_value_eur_excl_vat,
        reads.document_id,
        reads.total_document_reads AS total_reads,
        {# Shares of documents reads per user #}
        {{ dbt_utils.safe_divide(
            "reads.total_document_reads",
            "SUM(reads.total_document_reads) over (PARTITION BY reads.user_id)"
        )}} AS user_reads_shares,
        {{ dbt_utils.safe_divide(
            "user_ltv.lifetime_value_eur_excl_vat * reads.total_document_reads",
            "SUM(reads.total_document_reads) over (PARTITION BY reads.user_id)"
        )}} AS revenue_shares
    FROM
        {{ ref('int_mixpanel__daily_document_usage_per_user') }} AS reads
    INNER JOIN {{ ref('int_finance__user_lifetime_value') }} AS user_ltv
        ON user_ltv.user_id = reads.user_id
        AND reads.date BETWEEN user_ltv.starting_date
        AND user_ltv.ending_date
)
SELECT
    *
FROM
    user_ltv_shares_per_document

model.studocu.monetisation__institution_.name: monetisation__institution_monthly_metrics
model.studocu.monetisation__institution_.raw_code:
with 
    institutions as (
        select 
            i.id as institution_id 
            , i.phase as stage
            , i.population
            , i.country_id
            , ct.tier
        from {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__institution') }} i
        join {{ ref('country_tier') }} ct on ct.country_id = i.country_id
    ), 
    traffic as (
        select 
            institution_id 
            , date_trunc('month', view_date) as dt
            , sum(total_document_views) as views 
            , sum(premium_document_views) as premium_views 
        from {{ ref('content__document_view_institution_daily') }}
        where view_date >= '2020-01-01'
        group by 1, 2 
    ),
    revenue as (
        select 
            university_id as institution_id 
            , date_trunc('month', date) as dt
            , count(distinct user_id) as paying_subscribers
            , sum(daily_revenue_eur_excl_vat) as revenue_eur 
        from {{ ref('finance__daily_recurring_revenue') }}
        where university_id is not null
            and date >= '2020-01-01'
        group by 1, 2 
    ), 
    supply as (
        select 
            institution_id 
            , date_trunc('month', published_at) as dt
            , count(distinct id) as published_documents
            , count(distinct user_id) as contributors
        from {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__document') }}
        where published_at >= '2020-01-01'
        group by 1, 2 
    ), 
    direct_trials as (
        select 
            d.institution_id
            , date_trunc('month', t.doc_view_datetime) as dt
            , count(*) as direct_trials
            , count(distinct t.document_id) as converting_documents
        from {{ ref('content__last_doc_view_before_trial') }} t
        left join {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__document') }} d on d.id = t.document_id
        where t.doc_view_datetime >= '2020-01-01'
        group by 1, 2
    ), 


    everything_joined as (
        select
            t.institution_id 
            , i.stage
            , i.population
            , i.country_id
            , i.tier
            , t.dt 
            , t.views
            , t.premium_views
            , coalesce(r.paying_subscribers, 0) as paying_subscribers
            , coalesce(r.revenue_eur, 0) as revenue_eur
            , coalesce(s.published_documents, 0) as published_documents
            , coalesce(s.contributors, 0) as contributors
            , coalesce(d.direct_trials, 0) as direct_trials
            , coalesce(d.converting_documents, 0) as converting_documents
        from traffic t
        left join revenue r on r.institution_id = t.institution_id and r.dt = t.dt 
        left join supply s on s.institution_id = t.institution_id and s.dt = t.dt 
        left join direct_trials d on d.institution_id = t.institution_id and d.dt = t.dt 
        
        left join institutions i on i.institution_id = t.institution_id
        where i.institution_id is not null 
    )
    

select *
from everything_joined
order by institution_id, dt

model.studocu.content__single_view_users.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='incremental',
    unique_key='distinct_id',
    sort='event_datetime',
    dist='document_id'
) }}

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        event_datetime,
        distinct_id,
        document_id,
        mp_referring_domain,
        CASE
            WHEN mp_referring_domain LIKE '%google%'
            OR mp_referring_domain LIKE '%bing%'
            OR mp_referring_domain LIKE '%yahoo%' THEN 'seo_organic'
            ELSE 'non-organic'
        END AS doc_view_channel,
        etl_md5
    FROM {{ ref('int_content__document_view_minimal') }}
)

{% if is_incremental() %}

, new_data AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM base
    WHERE event_datetime > (SELECT MAX(event_datetime) FROM {{ this }})
),

distinct_ids_in_new_data AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT distinct_id
    FROM new_data
),

total_counts AS (
    SELECT distinct_id, COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM base
    WHERE distinct_id IN (SELECT distinct_id FROM distinct_ids_in_new_data)
    GROUP BY distinct_id
),

to_insert AS (
    SELECT nd.*
    FROM new_data nd
    JOIN total_counts tc ON nd.distinct_id = tc.distinct_id
    WHERE tc.total_count = 1
)

SELECT *
FROM (
    -- Keep existing rows unless the user now has more than one view
    SELECT m.*
    FROM {{ this }} m
    LEFT JOIN total_counts tc ON m.distinct_id = tc.distinct_id AND tc.total_count > 1
    WHERE tc.distinct_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    -- Add new rows for users with exactly one view
    SELECT * FROM to_insert
) AS updated_model

{% else %}

SELECT *
FROM base
WHERE 1=1
QUALIFY COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY distinct_id) = 1

{% endif %}

model.studocu.content__operational_spend.raw_code:
WITH dates AS (
    SELECT
        "date"
    FROM
        {{ ref('stg_general__calendar') }}
    WHERE
        "date" >= CAST(
            '2016-01-01' AS DATE
        )
),
operational_spend AS (
    SELECT
        p.created_at,
        p.institution_id,
        i.country_id,
        SUM(p.amount_eur) as budget_docs
    FROM 
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__payout') }} p
    LEFT JOIN
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__institution') }} i
        ON p.institution_id = i.id
    WHERE p.status = 'SUCCESS'
    GROUP BY 1,
             2,
             3
)
SELECT d.date as created_at,
       os.institution_id,
       os.country_id,
       COALESCE(os.budget_docs,0) as budget_docs
FROM
    dates d 
LEFT JOIN
    operational_spend os
    ON d.date = CAST(os.created_at as date)

WITH dates AS (
    SELECT
        "date"
    FROM
        {{ ref('stg_general__calendar') }}

        "date" >= CAST(
            '2016-01-01' AS DATE
        )
),
marketing_spend AS (
    SELECT
        d.date as created_at,
        platform as ad_channel,
        SUM(impressions) as impressions,
        SUM(clicks) as clicks,
        SUM(spend) as ad_spend
    FROM
        dates d
    LEFT JOIN
        {{ ref('int_marketing__daily_ads_insights') }} ar
        ON d.date = ar.date
    GROUP BY 1,
             2
    ORDER BY 1,
             2
)
SELECT
    created_at,
    ad_channel,
    COALESCE(impressions,0) as impressions,
    COALESCE(clicks,0) as clicks,
    COALESCE(ad_spend,0) as ad_spend
FROM

model.studocu.content__user_leaderboard.description: The table contains the leaderboard inputs for all uploaders for the current month. Every month, all fields (except user_id, institution_id and course_ids) are reset to 0, and recalculated daily for the running month. All metrics exclude activity by the uploader themselves (e.g. views exclude views from the uploader). Anonymous users (user_id = 0) and unybook@studocu.com (user_id = 2604634) are excluded as uploaders from the computations. Non-registered users' (user_id IS NULL) activities (i.e. downloads, views, etc.) are included in the computations.

total_points.name: total_points
total_points.description: Total points acquired by the user in the current month, defined as - 50 x upvotes + 50 x comments + 25 x views + 10 x uploads

upvotes.name: upvotes

comments.name: comments

views.name: views

uploads.name: uploads
uploads.description: The total number of uploads by the user in the current month

course_ids.name: course_ids
course_ids.description: A pipe (|) separated list of course_ids to which the user has uploaded, or which the user has manually followed (based on BE data)

with uploaders as (
    select distinct
        document.user_id,
        users.institution_id
    from
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__document') }} as document
    inner join
        {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__user') }} as users   
        on document.user_id = users.id
    where   
        user_id not in (0, 2604634) --user 0 is anonymous and 2604634 is unybook@studocu.com
)
select
    current_date as process_date,
    uploaders.user_id,
    uploaders.institution_id,
    coalesce(total_points.total_points,0) as total_points,
    coalesce(total_points.upvotes,0) as upvotes,
    coalesce(total_points.comments,0) as comments,
    coalesce(total_points.views,0) as views,
    coalesce(total_points.downloads,0) as downloads,
    coalesce(total_points.uploads,0) as uploads,
    courses.course_ids,
    {{
    dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key(
        [
            'uploaders.user_id',
            'uploaders.institution_id'
        ]
    )
    }} AS etl_md5
from
    uploaders
left join
    {{ ref('int_content__user_leaderboard_total_points') }} as total_points
    on uploaders.user_id = total_points.user_id
left join
    {{ ref('int_content__user_leaderboard_courses') }} as courses
    on uploaders.user_id = courses.user_id

model.studocu.content__documents_bringin.raw_code:
{{ config(
    sort='upload_complete_date',
    dist='distinct_id',
    on_schema_change="sync_all_columns"
) }}

WITH
-- Join last upload_clicked event before upload_complete having document inside the mp_current_url
upload_clicked AS (
    SELECT
        clicked.event_datetime AS upload_clicked_date,
        complete.event_datetime AS upload_complete_date,
        complete.distinct_id,
        complete.user_id,
        clicked.mp_current_url AS clicked_url,
        SPLIT_TO_ARRAY(TRIM(BOTH '[]' FROM complete.documents_ids), ',') AS uploaded_document_ids -- Convert string into array
    FROM {{ ref('stg_mixpanel__document_upload_complete_be') }} AS complete
    -- Join all upload_click events before upload complete within 24 hours, that has document inside their urls
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_mixpanel__upload_clicked') }} AS clicked ON complete.distinct_id = clicked.distinct_id 
        AND clicked.event_datetime < complete.event_datetime -- Join document clicked before complete
        AND ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (complete.event_datetime - clicked.event_datetime)) / 3600, 3) <= 24 -- Within 24 hours
        AND SPLIT_PART(clicked.mp_current_url, '/', 5) = 'document' -- URL is document
        AND SPLIT_PART(REGEXP_REPLACE(clicked.mp_current_url, '^.*/', ''), '?', 1) ~ '^[0-9]+$' -- Document id is numeric
    {% if is_incremental() %}
    WHERE complete.event_datetime::DATE = DATE('{{ var("logical_date") }}')
    {% endif %}
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY complete.distinct_id, upload_complete_date ORDER BY upload_clicked_date DESC) = 1 -- Keep only last relevant upload started
),
-- Additionally join upload_started event with same logic as previous CTE, to cover more cases (increases coverage from ~65% to ~80%)
upload_started AS (
    SELECT
        clicked.*,
        started.event_datetime AS upload_started_date,
        started.mp_referrer AS upload_started_referring_url,
        -- Extract document_id from URL whether from upload_started event, or upload_clicked depending on their existence
        SPLIT_PART(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(clicked.clicked_url, upload_started_referring_url), '^.*/', ''), '?', 1) AS referring_document_id
    FROM upload_clicked AS clicked
    -- Join all start uploads before upload complete within 24 hours, that has document inside their referring urls
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_mixpanel__document_upload_started') }} AS started ON clicked.distinct_id = started.distinct_id 
        AND started.event_datetime < clicked.upload_complete_date -- Join document upload started before complete
        AND ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (clicked.upload_complete_date - started.event_datetime)) / 3600, 3) <= 24 -- Within 24 hours
        AND SPLIT_PART(started.mp_referrer, '/', 5) = 'document' -- URL is document
        AND SPLIT_PART(REGEXP_REPLACE(started.mp_referrer, '^.*/', ''), '?', 1) ~ '^[0-9]+$' -- Document id is numeric
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY clicked.distinct_id, clicked.upload_complete_date ORDER BY upload_started_date DESC) = 1 -- Keep only last relevant upload started
)

SELECT
    upload_complete_date,
    referring_document_id::INT,
    uploaded_document_id::INT,
    distinct_id,
    user_id,
    {{
        dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key(
            [
                'upload_complete_date',
                'distinct_id',
                'uploaded_document_id',
                'referring_document_id',
                'user_id'
            ]
        )
    }} AS etl_md5
FROM
    upload_started AS b,
    b.uploaded_document_ids AS uploaded_document_id -- Using cross-join to explode array of uploaded document ids (1 document can bring multiple uploads)
WHERE referring_document_id IS NOT NULL -- Only uploads having document as referring url

model.studocu.content__cleaned_instituti.raw_code:
with raw_uni_logs as  -- adding derived parameters for cleaning 
(
SELECT
    logs.institution_id AS institution_id,
    logs.created_at as stage_change_valid_from,
    logs.current_stage AS from_stage,
    logs.new_stage AS to_stage,
    lag(logs.current_stage) over(partition by logs.institution_id order by logs.created_at asc) as prev_from_stage, 
    lag(logs.new_stage) over(partition by logs.institution_id order by logs.created_at asc) as prev_to_stage,
    lag(logs.current_stage,2) over(partition by logs.institution_id order by logs.created_at asc) as prev_prev_from_stage, 
    lag(logs.new_stage,2) over(partition by logs.institution_id order by logs.created_at asc) as prev_prev_to_stage,
    lead(logs.current_stage) over(partition by logs.institution_id order by logs.created_at asc) as next_from_stage, 
    lead(logs.new_stage) over(partition by logs.institution_id order by logs.created_at asc) as next_to_stage,
    DATEDIFF(day, logs.created_at, coalesce(lead(logs.created_at) over(partition by logs.institution_id order by logs.created_at asc),getdate())) as days_in_logged_stage,
    DATEDIFF(day, lag(logs.created_at) over(partition by logs.institution_id order by logs.created_at asc),logs.created_at) as prev_days_in_logged_stage
FROM
    {{ ref('stg_metrics_studocu__institution_stage_log') }} as logs
WHERE 
    true and 
    from_stage != to_stage  -- stage changed from and to should not be the same
and logs.created_at != '0002-11-30 BC'
ORDER BY 
    2,3 asc, 1 desc
), 

cleaning_to_fro_logs as -- remove to_fro changes 
(
    with mark_to_fro_record as -- mark cyclic stage changes (Eg: 1-> 2 -> 1) within 10 days (threshold)
    (
        SELECT 
            *, 
            case when days_in_logged_stage <= 10  and  
                    prev_to_stage = next_to_stage then 1
                when days_in_logged_stage <= 10  and     
                    prev_to_stage is null and 
                    from_stage = next_to_stage then 1
                else 0 end as flag_to_fro
        FROM 
           raw_uni_logs
    ),
    clean_to_fro_record as   -- remove cyclic stage changes
    (
        SELECT 
            * 
        FROM 
            mark_to_fro_record
        WHERE flag_to_fro = 0
    )
    
    SELECT                    -- recomputing derived parameters for further cleaning 
        institution_id, 
        stage_change_valid_from,
        from_stage, 
        to_stage,
        lead(from_stage) over(partition by institution_id order by stage_change_valid_from asc) as next_from_stage, 
        lead(to_stage) over(partition by institution_id order by stage_change_valid_from asc) as next_to_stage,
        lag(from_stage) over(partition by institution_id order by stage_change_valid_from asc) as prev_from_stage, 
        lag(to_stage) over(partition by institution_id order by stage_change_valid_from asc) as prev_to_stage,
        DATEDIFF(day, stage_change_valid_from, coalesce(lead(stage_change_valid_from) over(partition by institution_id order by stage_change_valid_from asc ),getdate())) as days_in_logged_stage,
        DATEDIFF(day, lag(stage_change_valid_from) over(partition by institution_id order by stage_change_valid_from asc),stage_change_valid_from) as prev_days_in_logged_stage,
        flag_to_fro
    FROM 
        clean_to_fro_record
),

cleaning_other_error_logs as 
(
    with mark_other_error_logs as 
    (

        SELECT 
            *, 
            case when 
                prev_days_in_logged_stage <= 10 and    -- Mark to combine step by step updates (1->2->3 = 1->3) within 10 days (threshold)
                to_stage != prev_from_stage and 
                from_stage = prev_to_stage then 1 
                else 0 end as flag_combine,
            case when 
                days_in_logged_stage <= 10 and          -- Mark the final to stage to combine
                to_stage = next_from_stage and 
                from_stage != next_to_stage then next_to_stage
                end as new_next_to_stage,  
            case when                                       -- Mark duplicate updates on consecutive days (1->2, 1->2 = 1->2) within 10 days (threshold)
                to_stage = prev_to_stage and 
                from_stage = prev_from_stage then 1 
                else 0 end as flag_duplicate,               -- Mark multiple updates on the same days to retain only the latest update of the day 
            case when 
                prev_days_in_logged_stage = 0 then 1 
                else 0 end as flag_mutiple_update
        FROM 
            cleaning_to_fro_logs
    ),
    
    clean_other_error_logs as              -- remove marked records and recomputing derived parameters for further cleaning 
    (
    
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        stage_change_valid_from,
        from_stage, 
        case when new_next_to_stage is not null then new_next_to_stage 
             else to_stage end as to_stage, -- updated new "to_stage" for step by step stage update logs combined into one stage log (Eg: 1->2->3 = 1->3)
        DATEDIFF(day, stage_change_valid_from, coalesce(lead(stage_change_valid_from) over(partition by institution_id order by stage_change_valid_from asc ),getdate())) as days_in_logged_stage
    FROM 
        mark_other_error_logs 
    WHERE 
        flag_duplicate = 0 and 
        flag_mutiple_update = 0 and 
        flag_combine = 0
    ORDER BY 
        2,3 asc, 1 desc
    ), 
    
    check_stage_sync as     -- check the stage sync among the stage logs (previous to_stage should be same as current from_stage )
    (
    SELECT 
        *,
        case when (lag(to_stage) over(partition by institution_id order by stage_change_valid_from asc) is null) then 0
             when (from_stage = lag(to_stage) over(partition by institution_id order by stage_change_valid_from asc)) then 0
             when (to_stage = lag(to_stage) over(partition by institution_id order by stage_change_valid_from asc)) then 1 
             else 0 end as flag_delete,  -- Sync records where there is a mismatch due to previous cleaning (`Eg: 1->2, 3->2 = 1->2 )   
        case when (lag(to_stage) over(partition by institution_id order by stage_change_valid_from asc) is null) then 0
             when (from_stage = lag(to_stage) over(partition by institution_id order by stage_change_valid_from asc)) then 0 
             else 1 end as flag_sync -- Mark non-sync records
    FROM 
        clean_other_error_logs 
    ORDER BY 
        2, 3, 1 desc
    
    )
    
    SELECT    -- Clean records to fix stage sync because of cleaning. The flag is retained to check if there is any sync issue from the raw data that were not cleaned before (external error).
        *, 
        case when DATEDIFF(day,stage_change_valid_from, max(stage_change_valid_from) over(partition by institution_id )) = 0 then 1 
             else 0 end as is_recent_stage_change_log 
    FROM 
        check_stage_sync 
    WHERE flag_delete = 0
), 

uni_age as( -- Earliest document date as the university creation date
SELECT 
    doc.institution_id, 
    DATE(MIN(doc.published_at)) as first_document_published_at
FROM 
    {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__document') }} as doc   
WHERE 
    doc.institution_id IN ( SELECT distinct cleaning_other_error_logs.institution_id FROM cleaning_other_error_logs)
    AND doc.published_at IS NOT NULL 
GROUP BY 
    1
)

SELECT
    logs.institution_id,
    trunc(stage_change_valid_from) as valid_from_date,
    trunc(coalesce(lead(stage_change_valid_from) over(partition by logs.institution_id order by stage_change_valid_from asc ),getdate())) as valid_until_date,
    from_stage,
    to_stage, 
    CASE WHEN to_stage > from_stage  
        THEN 'Upgraded'  
        ELSE 'Downgraded' 
    END as stage_change_type,
    DATEDIFF(day, trunc(stage_change_valid_from), trunc(coalesce(lead(stage_change_valid_from) over(partition by logs.institution_id order by stage_change_valid_from asc ),getdate()))) as days_in_logged_stage,
    is_recent_stage_change_log, 
    institution.phase as current_stage,
    DATEDIFF(day, first_document_published_at, stage_change_valid_from ) as institution_age_as_on_log_date,
    case when
        is_recent_stage_change_log = 1 and 
        institution.phase != to_stage then 1
        else flag_sync end as is_sync_error
FROM 
    cleaning_other_error_logs as logs
LEFT JOIN 
    {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__institution')}} as institution on institution.id =  logs.institution_id
LEFT JOIN 
    uni_age ON uni_age.institution_id = logs.institution_id
ORDER BY 
    1, 2

            *, 
            case when days_in_logged_stage <= 10  and  
                    prev_to_stage = next_to_stage then 1
                when days_in_logged_stage <= 10  and     
                    prev_to_stage is null and 
                    from_stage = next_to_stage then 1
                else 0 end as flag_to_fro
        FROM 
           raw_uni_logs
    ),
    clean_to_fro_record as   -- remove cyclic stage changes
    (
        SELECT 
            * 
        FROM 
            mark_to_fro_record
        WHERE flag_to_fro = 0
    )
    
    SELECT                    -- recomputing derived parameters for further cleaning 
        institution_id, 
        stage_change_valid_from,
        from_stage, 
        to_stage,
        lead(from_stage) over(partition by institution_id order by stage_change_valid_from asc) as next_from_stage, 
        lead(to_stage) over(partition by institution_id order by stage_change_valid_from asc) as next_to_stage,
        lag(from_stage) over(partition by institution_id order by stage_change_valid_from asc) as prev_from_stage, 
        lag(to_stage) over(partition by institution_id order by stage_change_valid_from asc) as prev_to_stage,
        DATEDIFF(day, stage_change_valid_from, coalesce(lead(stage_change_valid_from) over(partition by institution_id order by stage_change_valid_from asc ),getdate())) as days_in_logged_stage,
        DATEDIFF(day, lag(stage_change_valid_from) over(partition by institution_id order by stage_change_valid_from asc),stage_change_valid_from) as prev_days_in_logged_stage,
        flag_to_fro
    FROM 
        clean_to_fro_record
),

cleaning_other_error_logs as 
(
    with mark_other_error_logs as 
    (

        SELECT 
            *, 
            case when 
                prev_days_in_logged_stage <= 10 and    -- Mark to combine step by step updates (1->2->3 = 1->3) within 10 days (threshold)
                to_stage != prev_from_stage and 
                from_stage = prev_to_stage then 1 
                else 0 end as flag_combine,
            case when 
                days_in_logged_stage <= 10 and          -- Mark the final to stage to combine
                to_stage = next_from_stage and 
                from_stage != next_to_stage then next_to_stage
                end as new_next_to_stage,  
            case when                                       -- Mark duplicate updates on consecutive days (1->2, 1->2 = 1->2) within 10 days (threshold)
                to_stage = prev_to_stage and 
                from_stage = prev_from_stage then 1 
                else 0 end as flag_duplicate,               -- Mark multiple updates on the same days to retain only the latest update of the day 
            case when 
                prev_days_in_logged_stage = 0 then 1 
                else 0 end as flag_mutiple_update
        FROM 
            cleaning_to_fro_logs
    ),
    
    clean_other_error_logs as              -- remove marked records and recomputing derived parameters for further cleaning 
    (
    
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        stage_change_valid_from,
        from_stage, 
        case when new_next_to_stage is not null then new_next_to_stage 
             else to_stage end as to_stage, -- updated new "to_stage" for step by step stage update logs combined into one stage log (Eg: 1->2->3 = 1->3)
        DATEDIFF(day, stage_change_valid_from, coalesce(lead(stage_change_valid_from) over(partition by institution_id order by stage_change_valid_from asc ),getdate())) as days_in_logged_stage
    FROM 
        mark_other_error_logs 
    WHERE 
        flag_duplicate = 0 and 
        flag_mutiple_update = 0 and 
        flag_combine = 0
    ORDER BY 
        2,3 asc, 1 desc
    ), 
    
    check_stage_sync as     -- check the stage sync among the stage logs (previous to_stage should be same as current from_stage )
    (
    SELECT 
        *,
        case when (lag(to_stage) over(partition by institution_id order by stage_change_valid_from asc) is null) then 0
             when (from_stage = lag(to_stage) over(partition by institution_id order by stage_change_valid_from asc)) then 0
             when (to_stage = lag(to_stage) over(partition by institution_id order by stage_change_valid_from asc)) then 1 
             else 0 end as flag_delete,  -- Sync records where there is a mismatch due to previous cleaning (`Eg: 1->2, 3->2 = 1->2 )   
        case when (lag(to_stage) over(partition by institution_id order by stage_change_valid_from asc) is null) then 0
             when (from_stage = lag(to_stage) over(partition by institution_id order by stage_change_valid_from asc)) then 0 
             else 1 end as flag_sync -- Mark non-sync records
    FROM 
        clean_other_error_logs 
    ORDER BY 
        2, 3, 1 desc
    
    )
    
    SELECT    -- Clean records to fix stage sync because of cleaning. The flag is retained to check if there is any sync issue from the raw data that were not cleaned before (external error).
        *, 
        case when DATEDIFF(day,stage_change_valid_from, max(stage_change_valid_from) over(partition by institution_id )) = 0 then 1 
             else 0 end as is_recent_stage_change_log 
    FROM 
        check_stage_sync 
    WHERE flag_delete = 0
), 

uni_age as( -- Earliest document date as the university creation date
SELECT 
    doc.institution_id, 
    DATE(MIN(doc.published_at)) as first_document_published_at
FROM 
    "production"."production_studocu"."document" as doc   
WHERE 
    doc.institution_id IN ( SELECT distinct cleaning_other_error_logs.institution_id FROM cleaning_other_error_logs)
    AND doc.published_at IS NOT NULL 
GROUP BY 
    1
)

SELECT
    logs.institution_id,
    trunc(stage_change_valid_from) as valid_from_date,
    trunc(coalesce(lead(stage_change_valid_from) over(partition by logs.institution_id order by stage_change_valid_from asc ),getdate())) as valid_until_date,
    from_stage,
    to_stage, 
    CASE WHEN to_stage > from_stage  
        THEN 'Upgraded'  
        ELSE 'Downgraded' 
    END as stage_change_type,
    DATEDIFF(day, trunc(stage_change_valid_from), trunc(coalesce(lead(stage_change_valid_from) over(partition by logs.institution_id order by stage_change_valid_from asc ),getdate()))) as days_in_logged_stage,
    is_recent_stage_change_log, 
    institution.phase as current_stage,
    DATEDIFF(day, first_document_published_at, stage_change_valid_from ) as institution_age_as_on_log_date,
    case when
        is_recent_stage_change_log = 1 and 
        institution.phase != to_stage then 1
        else flag_sync end as is_sync_error
FROM 
    cleaning_other_error_logs as logs
LEFT JOIN 
    "production"."production_studocu"."institution" as institution on institution.id =  logs.institution_id
LEFT JOIN 
    uni_age ON uni_age.institution_id = logs.institution_id
ORDER BY 
    1, 2

model.studocu.product__user_lifecycle.raw_code:
{{ config(
    on_schema_change="append_new_columns"
) }}

WITH 
-- Table with users' first payments, subscription cancel dates (both current and previous) and user lifecycle group depending on certain rules
base AS (
    SELECT
        ds.user_id,
        ds.subscription_id,
        ct.country_tier AS user_country_tier,
        i.phase AS user_institution_stage,
        CASE
            WHEN i.level = 3 THEN 'High School'
            WHEN i.level ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN 'University' -- If level is numeric
            ELSE 'Unknown' END AS institution_type,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', ds.date)::DATE AS payment_month,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', '{{ var('logical_date') }}'::DATE) cycle_month, -- Pass cycle month we want to calculate data for
        payment_id,
        billing_cycle,
        pr.cancelled_at::DATE AS sub_cancelled,
        prev_cancel.cancelled_at::DATE AS prev_sub_cancelled,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ds.user_id, ds.subscription_id ORDER BY prev_cancel.id DESC) AS row_num, -- To get cancel date of previous subscription (if exists)
        
        -- If this is first payment, and user had not subscriptions before - define as new user
        CASE WHEN payment_month = cycle_month AND prev_sub_cancelled IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new,
        
        -- If there is payment before this month, and subscriptions is cancelled after this month (or not cancelled yet) - define as retained user
        CASE WHEN payment_month < cycle_month AND (DATE_TRUNC('month', sub_cancelled) > cycle_month OR sub_cancelled IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_retained,
        
        -- If churned during first month - we define him as new/rejoined that month, and churned on next month. Otherwise churned on cancel month
        CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', sub_cancelled) = cycle_month AND DATE_TRUNC('month', sub_cancelled) <> DATE_TRUNC('month', payment_month) THEN 1
             WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', sub_cancelled) = DATE_TRUNC('month', cycle_month - INTERVAL '1 month') AND DATE_TRUNC('month', sub_cancelled) = DATE_TRUNC('month', payment_month) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_churned, 
        
        -- If this is first payment, but before user had other subscription that was cancelled - define them as rejoined
        CASE WHEN payment_month = cycle_month AND prev_sub_cancelled IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_rejoined
        
    FROM {{ ref('int_finance__daily_sales') }} AS ds
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__payment_recurring') }} AS pr ON ds.subscription_id = pr.id -- Join subscription cancel date
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__payment_recurring') }} AS prev_cancel ON ds.user_id = prev_cancel.user_id AND ds.date > prev_cancel.cancelled_at -- Join all previous subscriptions to get previos sub cancel date
    
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__user') }} AS u ON ds.user_id = u.id -- Join users for country tier & university stage
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('country_tiers_full') }} AS ct ON u.country_id = ct.country_id
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_production_studocu__institution') }} AS i ON u.institution_id = i.id
    -- We do not need Recurring payments as they create duplicates for retained users and we can get cancel date on subscription level for all first payments
    WHERE payment_recurring_type = 'First payment' 
    ORDER BY 1, 2 
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        cycle_month,
        billing_cycle,
        COALESCE(user_country_tier::VARCHAR, 'no_tier') AS user_country_tier,
        COALESCE(user_institution_stage::VARCHAR, 'no_stage') AS user_institution_stage,
        institution_type,
        SUM(is_new) AS is_new,
        SUM(is_retained) AS is_retained,
        SUM(is_churned) AS is_churned,
        SUM(is_rejoined) AS is_rejoined
    FROM base
    WHERE row_num = 1 -- If user had multiple previous subscriptions - we keep only the last one, to get prev subscription cancel date (needed for new/rejoined users)
